summary.zh: 官方 Python SDK（pip 包 typesafe-sdk，要求 Python ≥ 3.10），提供同步/异步客户端与 Choice/Score/Noul 类型，默认读取 TYPESAFE_API_KEY。
summary.en: Official Python SDK (pip package typesafe-sdk, Python >= 3.10) with sync/async clients and Choice/Score/Noul types; reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY by default.

summary.zh: 官方 TypeScript/JavaScript SDK（npm 包 @typesafe-ai/sdk），答案类型可自动推断，内置重试与错误分类。
summary.en: Official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK (npm package @typesafe-ai/sdk) with inferred answer types, built-in retries and error classes.

summary.zh: 官方 Agent Skill：教 Claude Code、Codex 等编码助手正确调用 System One API 的技能包。
summary.en: Official agent skills teaching coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex how to call the System One API.

summary.zh: 官方适配器：用普通 LLM API 模拟 TypeSafeClient，便于对照测试或降级运行。
summary.en: Official adapter that emulates TypeSafeClient on top of ordinary LLM APIs for A/B testing or fallback.

summary.zh: Browser Use 出品的极速网页 Agent：Jev 负责选择操作与目标元素，小模型只在需要打字时介入。发布首周星数最高的 Jev 项目。
summary.en: Browser Use's fast web agent: Jev picks each action and target element while a small LLM only types when needed. The most-starred Jev project of launch week.

summary.zh: 基于 Jev 的浏览器自动化实现。
summary.en: Browser automation driven by Jev.

summary.zh: Claude Code 插件：用 Jev 逐条判断历史工具调用的去留，替代摘要式上下文压缩；保留的内容原样保留。社区对该策略存在争议。
summary.en: Claude Code plugin that replaces compaction summaries with Jev decisions on every past tool call; kept content stays verbatim. The approach is debated in the community.

summary.zh: Claude Code 插件：按任务选择最便宜且够用的模型。
summary.en: Claude Code plugin that routes each task to the cheapest sufficient model.

summary.zh: 分阶段代码审查流程与本地面板。
summary.en: A staged code-review workflow with a local dashboard.

summary.zh: MCP 服务器：把校验、筛选、排序等判断暴露为 Agent 可调用的工具。
summary.en: MCP server exposing typed judgments (screening, filtering, ranking) as agent tools.

summary.zh: MCP 连接器：让 Agent 直接调用 Jev。
summary.en: MCP connector giving agents direct access to Jev.

summary.zh: 编码 Agent 的安全闸门：对每次工具调用给出 deny/ask/allow 风险判断，并标记提示注入；支持多种编码助手。
summary.en: A safety gate for coding agents: risk-scores every tool call as deny/ask/allow and flags prompt injection across many coding assistants.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 审查 Agent Skill 与 MCP 代码中的可疑行为（中文说明项目）。
summary.en: Reviews agent skills and MCP code for suspicious behavior using Jev (Chinese-language project).

summary.zh: 受 Jev 启发的开源实现：在开源模型上复刻“语义 if”接口，3090 显卡可本地运行。原名 OpenJev，作者声明与 TypeSafe 无关；不是 Jev 权重开源。
summary.en: An inspired open-source reimplementation of the 'semantic if' interface on open models, runnable on a single RTX 3090. Formerly OpenJev; the author states it is independent of TypeSafe. Not the Jev weights.

summary.zh: 基于 Qwen3.5 的迷你 Jev 式决策模型，可自行训练并在本机运行。
summary.en: A tiny Jev-like decision-model family built on Qwen3.5 that you can train and run yourself.

summary.zh: 0.6B 参数的 Jev 复刻：并行决策、动态候选与端到端训练流程。社区项目，与官方无关。
summary.en: A 0.6B-parameter Jev replica with parallel decisions, dynamic candidates, and an end-to-end training pipeline. Community project, unrelated to TypeSafe.

summary.zh: PostgreSQL 扩展：用自然语言对表格行做判断。许可证未被 GitHub 识别为标准开源协议。
summary.en: A PostgreSQL extension for asking plain-language questions over table rows. Its license is not recognized by GitHub as a standard open-source license.

summary.zh: LlamaIndex 出品：用 Jev 做快速文档分类与子文档边界识别。
summary.en: From LlamaIndex: fast document classification and sub-document boundary detection with Jev.

summary.zh: Hono 中间件：按语义把请求路由到不同处理器。
summary.en: Hono middleware that routes HTTP requests by meaning.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 选择数据源、理解查询并按相关性排序的网页搜索（基于 Search1API）。
summary.en: Web search where Jev picks sources, interprets queries, and ranks relevance (built on Search1API).

summary.zh: 用人工反馈与 GEPA 校准 Jev 判断函数。
summary.en: Calibrates Jev judgment functions from human feedback using GEPA.

summary.zh: 在 Monad 链上每个区块做一次买卖判断（默认 dry-run 模拟）。仅供研究，不构成任何投资建议；实盘风险自担。
summary.en: Makes one buy/sell decision per Monad block (dry-run by default). Research only — not investment advice; live trading carries real risk.

summary.zh: 英文精选清单，按 13 类收录数百个项目与讨论；作者提醒同日批量提交的项目未经验证。
summary.en: A curated English list of hundreds of projects and discussions across 13 categories; the author warns that same-day batch submissions are unvetted.

summary.zh: 中文精选列表：官方资料、应用、Agent 工具与开源复现，附中文上手指南。
summary.en: A Chinese curated list of official resources, apps, agent tooling, and replicas, with a Chinese quick-start guide.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 筛选历史 Hacker News 评论中的可核验预测；仓库包含预注册试验、实际调用代码和作者发布的结果数据，尚未处理完整档案。
summary.en: Screens historical Hacker News comments for checkable predictions with Jev; includes a preregistered pilot, calling code and author-published results, but not a completed full-archive run.

summary.zh: Rust 代码审查工具：解析源码后向 Jev 提交局部、类型化的维护性判断，并由代码汇成带位置和建议的发现；安全规则需另行启用。
summary.en: Rust code-review tool that asks Jev typed questions about parsed source units, then composes located findings and suggested actions; security rules are opt-in.

summary.zh: pi 的浏览器与 macOS 桌面 Agent 扩展：Jev 根据可见文本、控件和目标选择单步动作，执行循环设有步数和人工复核边界。
summary.en: A pi browser and macOS desktop agent extension: Jev chooses one action from visible text, controls and the goal, within a bounded loop with human-review gates.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 的 Noul、Choice、Score 比对基准合同与扫描件 OCR 文本，区分实质变化和识别噪声，并把低于作者阈值的结果交给人工复审；含真实 API 调用与一致性测试。
summary.en: Compares a baseline contract with scanned-copy OCR text using Jev Noul, Choice and Score questions, separates substantive changes from recognition noise and sends results below the author's cutoff to human review; includes a real API call and consistency tests.

summary.zh: Jev 决策的对抗评估资料库：提供 typed questions、单处改动样本、直接调用 TypeSafe API 的脚本和作者结果；代码与数据许可证不同，鲁棒性指标未由本站复算。
summary.en: An adversarial Jev decision benchmark with typed questions, single-edit variants, a direct TypeSafe API evaluator and author-published results. Code and data have different licenses; robustness figures were not independently reproduced.

summary.zh: 为编码 Agent 检索仓库上下文的 CLI：用 Jev 判断目录、文件与代码单元的任务相关性，输出带行号的原文片段；待评估源码可能发往外部服务。
summary.en: A coding-agent CLI that uses Jev to judge the relevance of folders, files and source units, then returns line-referenced excerpts; eligible source content may be sent to an external provider.

summary.zh: Jev 请求预检查工具：离线规则筛结构缺陷，再以 Jev Noul 判断语义问题，给开发者警告与修改建议；语义层需要外部 API。
summary.en: Lints Jev requests with offline structural rules and Jev Noul judgments for semantic defects, then reports suggested fixes; the semantic layer needs an external API.

summary.zh: 编码 Agent 的浏览器 MCP/CLI：Jev 每步选择动作与元素，客户端校验返回后驱动 Chrome；仓库的速度基准只代表作者测试环境。
summary.en: A browser MCP server and CLI for coding agents: Jev selects an action and element each step, and the client validates the reply before driving Chrome. Speed benchmarks are author-reported.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 的 Noul 为社区消息输出多种风险类别概率，供 Bot、CLI、API、MCP 共用策略；默认只标记，模型故障时放行并记录错误。
summary.en: Uses Jev Noul questions to score community-message risks across bots, CLI, API and MCP interfaces; defaults to flag-only and leaves messages alone on model failure.

summary.zh: 连接 TypeSafe System One 的 MCP 工具、可嵌入 DecisionModel 和编码助手插件；源码提供请求校验与预算控制，插件提示不替代宿主权限。
summary.en: MCP tools, an embeddable DecisionModel and a coding-agent plugin for TypeSafe System One, with request validation and budget controls; plugin advice does not replace host permissions.

summary.zh: 用 Jev Choice 从合法动作中选择安卓设备下一步，配合 SQLite 任务状态、执行前记录及执行后观察验证；需要 USB 调试和外部 API。
summary.en: Uses Jev Choice to select the next valid Android action, with SQLite task state, a mutation journal and post-action observation; requires USB debugging and an external API.

summary.zh: 把 Jev 从单个封闭判断逐级接入 Agent hooks 的教学代码库，含 TypeSafe/OpenRouter 真调用、离线 mock、交互演示与测试；速度和成本数字为作者材料。
summary.en: A progressive code lab from one bounded Jev decision to agent hooks, with live TypeSafe/OpenRouter calls, an offline mock, demos and tests; speed and cost figures are author-reported.

summary.zh: macOS 电脑操作 Beta：以 Jev Choice 从屏幕状态选动作与控件，代码执行并复核下一帧；操作真实鼠标键盘，应先 dry-run。
summary.en: A macOS computer-use beta that asks Jev Choice to select actions and controls from screen state, then executes and checks the next frame; it drives real input, so start with a dry run.

summary.zh: 软件工厂监工：Jev 持续评估 Codex/OpenCode 工人的完成度、需求满足与测试充分性，代码决定继续、纠偏或停止。
summary.en: A software-factory foreman: Jev continuously scores Codex/OpenCode workers on completeness, requirements, and test sufficiency while code decides to continue, steer, or stop.

summary.zh: 原版 Minecraft 通关 Agent：GPT-6 Astra 规划、Jev 逐动作选择，最佳全程 8 分 43 秒、131 次 Jev 决策，不修改游戏规则。
summary.en: A vanilla-Minecraft speedrun agent where GPT-6 Astra plans and Jev picks each action; best verified run 8m43s with 131 Jev decisions and no rule changes.

summary.zh: NES 超级马里奥实验控制器：模拟器状态转结构化 JSON（无截图），Jev Choice 从 7 个合法手柄动作中选择；仓库不含 ROM。
summary.en: An experimental NES Super Mario controller that feeds structured JSON state (no screenshots) to a Jev Choice over seven legal inputs; ships no ROM.

summary.zh: droidrun 出品的安卓 Agent：Jev 经 Mobilerun API 操作真机，附 React Studio、CLI 与请求级延迟记录；Uber 演示 9 步约 21 秒停在支付页。
summary.en: droidrun's Android agent where Jev drives a real phone via the Mobilerun API, with a React studio, CLI, and per-request latency traces; the Uber demo does 9 actions in ~21 s and stops at payment.

summary.zh: 语音控制真实浏览器：流式部分转写触发一次 Jev 请求（9-11 问），约 300ms 决定执行/等待/询问/忽略；文本只由代码提取、Jev 挑选。
summary.en: Voice control for a real browser: each partial transcript fires one 9-11 question Jev request (~300 ms) to act, wait, ask, or ignore; text is extracted by code and only picked by Jev.

summary.zh: MuJoCo 四旋翼仅凭机载相机过五站障碍课程：Jev 以 2.5Hz 做战术判断，50Hz 安全反射与 500Hz 控制器保留否决权。
summary.en: A MuJoCo quadrotor flies a five-station course from its onboard camera alone; Jev judges tactics at 2.5 Hz while 50 Hz reflexes and a 500 Hz controller keep the veto.

summary.zh: Codex 逐调用模型路由：Jev 同时选模型与推理强度（含工具后续轮），Jev 只见有界决策状态，出错 fail-open。
summary.en: Per-call model routing for Codex: Jev picks model and thinking effort together (continuations included) from a bounded decision state, failing open on any error.

summary.zh: Claude Code 插件：命令跑完后、结果回传主模型前，用 Jev 逐块判断 Bash 输出是否需要保留；文档、错误与 git diff 豁免。
summary.en: A Claude Code plugin that prunes noisy Bash output after the command runs but before the LLM sees it, one Jev noul per chunk, with documents, errors, and git diff exempt.

summary.zh: Neo4j 图导航演示：每跳用 Choice 选出边、Noul 判目标，同请求一次往返，再对概率做束搜索渲染路径；schema 动态自省。
summary.en: A Neo4j navigation demo where each hop asks one Choice over outgoing edges plus a goal noul in a single round trip, then beam-searches the probabilities; schema is introspected live.

summary.zh: Pi 编码 agent 的决策层：闸门一次请求判破坏性/外传/超范围/影响，输出裁判查泄密；默认 shadow 提示，错误一律 fail-open。
summary.en: A decision layer for the Pi coding agent: one gated request judges destructiveness, exfiltration, scope, and impact, plus an output judge for secrets; shadow mode by default and every error fails open.

summary.zh: 视频真话仪表盘：按预设逐句给视频打分、标记回避与炒作，渲染 16:9 成片；整场辩论约 0.05 美元。
summary.en: A live meter for videos: every sentence scored against a preset, dodges and hype flagged, rendered as a postable 16:9 edit; a full debate costs about $0.05.

summary.zh: zsh 的 fish 式历史建议：Jev Choice 从最近 100 条去重历史里判断你在补全哪条，灰显在光标后并附概率。
summary.en: Fish-style zsh autosuggestions where a Jev Choice ranks which of your last 100 distinct commands you are completing, shown in grey with its probability.

summary.zh: 没有语言模型写一字的聊天命令条：Jev 选工具、参数来源与是否确认，代码调 MCP 并用工具数据拼回复，页面值皆有出处。
summary.en: A chat command bar where no LLM writes a word: Jev picks the tool, argument sources, and confirmations while code calls MCP servers and builds replies from tool data.

summary.zh: 趣味 Chrome 扩展：代码预筛广告形 DOM 候选，Jev 每候选一个 Noul 判“是否广告”，P≥0.70 移除；作者明示非真广告拦截。
summary.en: A fun Chrome extension where code pre-filters ad-shaped DOM candidates and one Jev noul per candidate decides "is this an ad?"; elements above 0.70 are removed. The author calls it a toy, not uBlock.

summary.zh: 开源 Gmail 分诊：每封 3 问分五个托盘并打紧急度，只读不代发；1000 封约 1 分钟约 3 美分，纠错与概率本地留痕。
summary.en: Open-source Gmail triage: three questions per message sort five trays with urgency, strictly read-only; 1,000 emails in about a minute for a few cents, with corrections stored locally.

summary.zh: Home Assistant 集成：Noul/Choice/Score 问答变成传感器实体与自动化动作，附 25 个蓝图、Assist 语音路由与每日花费统计；与 TypeSafe 无关的社区作品。
summary.en: A Home Assistant integration that turns Noul/Choice/Score questions into sensor entities and automation actions, with 25 blueprints, Assist routing, and daily cost reporting; community-made, unaffiliated with TypeSafe.

summary.zh: 一个会变形的输入框：一次 Jev 调用 14 问判断输入应变成日程卡/清单/分账/取色等哪种 UI，日期金额由确定性代码计算，默认离线兜底。
summary.en: An input that becomes what you mean: one 14-question Jev call morphs the box into an event card, checklist, bill splitter, or color picker, while dates and math stay deterministic with an offline fallback.

summary.zh: 把 agent 评估与护栏做成 Jev 决策：一条 trace 一次请求并行 8 项判定，千分之几美分、数百毫秒，可跑全量流量；后端可选 TypeSafe/Vercel、本地 Kev/Laya 或普通 LLM。
summary.en: Evals and guardrails as Jev decisions: eight parallel judgments per trace in one request at a few thousandths of a cent, fast enough for every trace; backends span TypeSafe/Vercel, local Kev/Laya, or a plain LLM.

summary.zh: Claude Code 的校准上下文筛：每个大工具结果分块过一个 Noul“任务是否需要”，高置信不需要的替换为存根+摘要+召回键，不确定的保留。
summary.en: A calibrated context sieve for Claude Code: every large tool result is split and judged block-by-block; confident-no blocks become stub-plus-summary with a recall key, while uncertain ones stay.

summary.zh: 手机对话副驾（安卓主仓 + Windows/macOS 姊妹仓）：读屏采集对话，Jev 判断意图与情绪并给候选排序，悬浮窗一键填入、发送永远手动；不依赖任何平台接口。
summary.en: A mobile chat copilot (Android hub plus Windows/macOS siblings) that reads the screen, lets Jev judge intent and mood and rank drafts, then fills the input box — sending stays manual, no platform APIs involved.

summary.zh: SemIf 作者的开放模型版：在 3090 或浏览器里跑“语义 if”接口模式。独立项目，与 Jev/TypeSafe 无关，非 Jev 权重开源。
summary.en: The SemIf author's open-models edition of the semantic-if interface, runnable on a 3090 or in the browser. Independent and unaffiliated with Jev or TypeSafe; not Jev weights.

summary.zh: 诺基亚应用研究出品：无需微调把任意 LLM 变成 Jev 式校准决策端点（序翻转率与校准误差显著改善），可经 vLLM 服务化。
summary.en: From Nokia applied research: turn any LLM into a Jev-style calibrated decision endpoint without fine-tuning (measurably better order-flip and calibration error), servable via vLLM.

summary.zh: 开源 System One 决策模型：非自回归、宣称亚 15ms、可本地部署的 Jev 替代。社区实现，与 TypeSafe 无关。
summary.en: An open-source System One decision model: non-autoregressive, sub-15 ms claims, local drop-in alternative. Community work, unaffiliated with TypeSafe.

summary.zh: Featherless 出品：直接读开放模型 logits 做结构化分类/评分，免登录公共 demo（2k 上下文、限速 2 RPS），附评测框架。
summary.en: From Featherless: read open-model logits directly for structured classification and scoring, with a no-login public demo (2k context, 2 RPS) and an eval framework.

summary.zh: 基于 DiffusionGemma 的开源 Jev 兼容决策服务器，本地可跑。社区复刻，与官方无关。
summary.en: An open, Jev-compatible decision server built on DiffusionGemma that runs locally. A community replica, unrelated to TypeSafe.

summary.zh: 把本地语言模型转成 Jev 式结构化决策模型，支持文本与图像输入。独立实现，非 Jev 权重。
summary.en: Turn local language models into Jev-style structured decision models over text and images. Independent implementation, not Jev weights.

summary.zh: 用 SGLang 服务 Qwen3.6-35B 实现 TypeSafe/Jev HTTP API：每容器一张 B200、radix 缓存与可断 prefill CUDA 图，附 Modal 一键部署与冒烟测试。
summary.en: Serves Qwen3.6-35B on SGLang behind the TypeSafe/Jev HTTP API: one B200 per container, radix caching, breakable prefill CUDA graphs, plus Modal deploys and a smoke test.

summary.zh: 基于 GliFormer 的自托管 Jev 替代（LangChain 作者之一出品）：drop-in 兼容，跑在自己的机器上。社区项目，与 TypeSafe 无关。
summary.en: A self-hosted, GliFormer-powered drop-in replacement for Jev by a LangChain author; runs on your own machine. Community project, unaffiliated with TypeSafe.

summary.zh: 独立开源的非自回归 System 1 决策引擎（自有模型，非 Jev 实现、更非 Jev 权重开源）：对任意文本输出 Choice/Score/是否判断，可本地或经兼容接口服务，也出现在 JevBench 等第三方评测里。
summary.en: An independent open-source non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine (its own model — neither a Jev implementation nor Jev weights): typed choice, score, and yes/no decisions over any text, served locally or behind compatible APIs, and measured by third-party boards like JevBench.

summary.zh: 社区维护的核验型目录：收录 944 个 Jev 开源项目并标注证据。
summary.en: A community-maintained, verified catalog of 944 open-source Jev projects with evidence labels.

summary.zh: 面向 Jev 工具的精选清单。
summary.en: A curated list of tools built for Jev.

summary.zh: Jev / TypeSafe System One 应用、库与资源精选（CC0 发布）。
summary.en: A curated list of Jev / TypeSafe System One applications, libraries, and resources, published under CC0.

summary.zh: Jev 用例、工作流与 agent skills 集合。
summary.en: A collection of Jev use cases, workflows, and agent skills.

summary.zh: WXT 浏览器扩展：Jev 判断页面杂项元素并移除，清理规则可存为可复用模板。
summary.en: A WXT browser extension where Jev spots page clutter for removal, with reusable template rules.

summary.zh: 把模型、子代理、Skill、MCP 工具与 CLI 变成一个候选集：Jev 答一道 Choice，路由器负责可用性、权限、风险与确认；默认只决策不执行。
summary.en: Models, subagents, skills, MCP tools, and CLIs become one candidate set: Jev answers a single Choice while the router enforces availability, permissions, risk, and confirmation; decision-only by default.

summary.zh: 本地编码 agent 网关：把“下一步调哪个工具”交给 Jev，其余流量原样走原有 LLM；兼容 Codex/Claude Code/OpenCode/Kilo 与订阅登录。
summary.en: A local gateway for coding agents that hands the "which tool next" decision to Jev while everything else flows to your usual LLM untouched; works with Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Kilo, and subscription logins.

summary.zh: Jev 级决策模型基准（95 个系统在线排行，Jev 1.13 现列第 4）：冻结方法、封存决策与 SHA-256 清单，与 TypeSafe 无关。
summary.en: A benchmark for Jev-class decision models with a live board of 95 systems (Jev 1.13 currently #4): frozen method, sealed decisions, and a SHA-256 manifest; unaffiliated with TypeSafe.

summary.zh: jarvis 内核的 Windows 版：窗口截图 + 本地离线 OCR 读微信/KakaoTalk，Jev 判断意图情绪、给 3 条候选一键填入；发送永远手动。
summary.en: The Windows sibling of the Jev chat copilot: window screenshots plus offline OCR read WeChat or KakaoTalk, Jev judges intent and mood and offers three ranked drafts; sending stays manual.

summary.zh: Ruby 决策模型客户端：一套 Client 走 OpenRouter（默认）或 TypeSafe 直连，Noul/Score 返回校准概率，无运行时依赖。
summary.en: The decision-model client for Ruby: one Client over OpenRouter (default) or direct TypeSafe, returning calibrated noul/score answers with zero runtime dependencies.

summary.zh: CodexQA 技能：以页面内索引代替视觉模型做浏览器自动化，Jev 只从已索引控件中选择，Playwright 执行；回放、目标运行与站点探索共用同一索引。
summary.en: A CodexQA skill that replaces vision GUI models with an in-page index: Jev chooses only among indexed controls while Playwright acts; replay, goal runs, and site exploration share the index.

summary.zh: TypeSafe Jev 的 Python 批处理代理：多个独立状态并发逐条调用官方 API，再按输入顺序输出 Apache Arrow 流；附 Python 与 JavaScript 读取器，非官方原生批量接口。
summary.en: A Python batching proxy for TypeSafe Jev: calls the official API once per independent state concurrently, then streams ordered Apache Arrow results, with Python and JavaScript readers; not a native batch API.

summary.zh: 浏览器业务流程测试：Jev 初次定位页面控件并记录语义路径，后续可无模型回放；代码通过请求、API/数据库断言判定成败。
summary.en: Browser business-flow tests: Jev initially grounds controls and records semantic paths for model-free replay; code decides verdicts from requests and API/database assertions.

summary.zh: 交互式 Jev 决策评测台：实际 TypeSafe 基线与模拟器、独立模型及 judge 逐题比较并保存执行追踪；默认托管模拟器会接收场景文本。
summary.en: An interactive Jev decision playground comparing a real TypeSafe baseline with an emulator, independent model and judge while saving execution traces; its default hosted emulator receives scenario text.

summary.zh: IRS 表单 PDF 文本页分类器：Jev Choice 选表单和页面类别，按置信度门控后续路由；英文联邦表单限定，作者评测数据未由本站复测。
summary.en: An IRS PDF text-page classifier using Jev Choice for form and page kind with a confidence gate for routing; limited to English federal forms and not independently benchmarked here.

summary.zh: TypeSafe 官方 n8n 社区节点：对每个 item 调用 System One 的 Choice、Score、Noul；Evaluate 附加结构化答案，Route 按答案或置信度把 item 分发到预设输出。
summary.en: TypeSafe official n8n community node calls System One Choice, Score, and Noul per item; Evaluate attaches typed answers and Route dispatches items by answer or confidence.

summary.zh: TypeSafe 官方工作流评测代码：复现发票、客服、代理轨迹和安保事件的有界决策评测，将 Jev 与其他提供商按参考模型动作一致性、成本和耗时对照；一致率不等于真实业务正确率。
summary.en: Official workflow evaluation code for invoice, support, agent-trace, and security decisions; compares Jev and other providers on agreement with reference-model actions, cost, and time, which does not establish ground-truth business accuracy.

summary.zh: NetHack 5.0 游戏代理：代码读终端画面并枚举合法动作，Jev Choice 选一步，motor 发送对应按键；仓库有运行记录，未核实通关。
summary.en: A NetHack 5.0 agent where code reads the terminal and enumerates legal actions, Jev Choice picks one, and a motor sends the corresponding keys; runs are documented but ascension is unverified.

summary.zh: 从移动 App 验收目标探索 Appium 操作路径：Jev 从屏幕现有动作中选择，工具生成固定选择器的 WebdriverIO 测试并无模型回放；缺少断言时须人工复核。
summary.en: Explores Appium paths from mobile acceptance goals with Jev choosing on-screen actions, then generates fixed-selector WebdriverIO tests and replays without a model; goals without assertions need review.

summary.zh: Jev 驱动的 RAG 入库与检索管线：段落杂质和指令筛选、片段相关/冲突判断及可回答性门控；支持多种向量库，无 key 时降级为普通检索，评测数字为作者自报。
summary.en: A Jev-driven RAG ingestion and retrieval pipeline with paragraph screening, passage relevance/conflict checks, and an answerability gate; supports several vector stores, degrades without a key, and reports author-measured benchmarks.

summary.zh: 风险画像监控服务：You.com 检索、Jev Noul/Score/Choice 分别做威胁门控、查询和证据排序、级别判断，代码控制调查预算并由 Qwen 起草带来源报告；效果为作者材料。
summary.en: A profile-based risk monitor using You.com search and Jev Noul/Score/Choice for threat gating, query and evidence ranking, and severity; code owns the investigation budget while Qwen drafts source-linked reports. Outcomes are author-reported.

summary.zh: Omarchy/Hyprland 语音桌面助手：转写后用 OpenRouter Jev 选应用、工具、代理或回答路线，按风险门控桌面动作；文本回答另用聊天模型，macOS 有作者移植。
summary.en: A voice desktop assistant for Omarchy/Hyprland: OpenRouter Jev routes transcribed speech to apps, tools, agents, or answers with risk-gated actions; another chat model writes answers, and the author provides a macOS port.

summary.zh: Claude Code 的完成证据检查器：代码解析测试与 lint 结果，Jev 核对明确条件并记本地收据；自动 Stop hook 目前为 shadow 模式，active 阻断尚未发布。
summary.en: A Claude Code completion-evidence checker: code parses test and lint results, Jev checks explicit criteria, and local receipts preserve findings; its automatic Stop hook is shadow-only, with active blocking not yet released.

summary.zh: 可语音操控 Claude、Codex 与 Grok 会话的桌面应用；可选 TypeSafe Jev 做封闭路由判断，无 Jev key 时由另一模型兜底。本站未实机验收。
summary.en: A desktop voice client for Claude, Codex, and Grok sessions; optional TypeSafe Jev makes bounded routing decisions, with another model as fallback when no Jev key is configured. This site did not run the app.

summary.zh: Claude Code 的 Jev 工具包：含工具调用闸门、任务层级选择、搜索与浏览等集成；`airlock/client.py` 真调官方 System One，模型失败可 fail-open，作者性能数据未复测。
summary.en: A Jev kit for Claude Code with tool-call guards, task-tier selection, search, and browser integrations; `airlock/client.py` calls official System One, can fail open on model errors, and has author-reported performance.

summary.zh: 知识库写入准入的可复现评测：85 条合成案例比较 Jev、Clef 和 Kev，对新记录的冲突、重述及变义做封闭判断并模拟接纳或人工复核；成绩不代表生产正确率。
summary.en: A reproducible knowledge-write admission study using 85 synthetic cases to compare Jev, Clef, and Kev on contradictions, restatements, and changed meaning, then simulate admit versus review; scores do not establish production accuracy.

summary.zh: PageIndex 章节树与 Jev 组合检索长 PDF：Choice 逐层选章节/页面，Noul 检查候选页是否提供答案；不用向量库或嵌入，但须 PageIndex 云端和 TypeSafe 双 API key。
summary.en: Searches long PDFs with a PageIndex section tree and Jev Choice over nodes/pages plus Noul answerability checks. No vector DB or embeddings, but both PageIndex cloud and TypeSafe API keys are required.

summary.zh: Claude Code auto mode 的 Jev 权限预判 mod：八个 Noul 和代码阈值决定 allow/deny/defer，不确定交原生分类器；命令与近期消息可能发送 TypeSafe，作者安全测量未复测。
summary.en: A Jev permission precheck mod for Claude Code auto mode: eight Nouls and code thresholds decide allow, deny, or defer to the built-in classifier. Commands and recent messages may go to TypeSafe; safety measurements are author-reported.

summary.zh: 稀薄气体平板流课程示例：Jev 选择流型、几何、气体与量值角色，代码计算置信度门控和物理求解；包含可离线重放的答案与作者求解器校验。
summary.en: A rarefied-gas parallel-plate teaching example: Jev selects flow, geometry, gas, and quantity roles while code gates confidence and runs the physics solver; recorded answers replay offline and solver validation is author-provided.

summary.zh: 非官方 .NET TypeSafe/Jev 客户端：提供类型化 Noul、Choice、Score 结果、可注入 HttpClient、取消和重试；不属于 TypeSafe 官方 SDK。
summary.en: An unofficial .NET TypeSafe/Jev client with typed Noul, Choice, and Score answers, injectable HttpClient, cancellation, and retries; not a TypeSafe first-party SDK.

summary.zh: ComfyUI 的 System One 判断节点，提供 TypeSafe Jev 和本地 Laya 两种后端，可用 Choice/Noul/Score 路由图流程；仓库可见演示主要用 Laya，不能当作 Jev 实测。
summary.en: ComfyUI System One nodes with TypeSafe Jev and local Laya backends for Choice/Noul/Score workflow branching; visible demos mainly use Laya and are not Jev performance evidence.

summary.zh: Pi 编码助手的有界源码检索：字面/正则走 ripgrep，本地索引可选，用户显式启用后用 TypeSafe 分类当前片段并返回行号与部分覆盖标记；不是全库无遗漏证明。
summary.en: Bounded source search for Pi: ripgrep handles exact/regex, a local index is optional, and explicitly enabled TypeSafe classification ranks current snippets with line references and partial-coverage markers; it does not prove exhaustive absence.

summary.zh: 提供编码 Agent 共用的 MCP/CLI 判断服务，可选 TypeSafe Jev 后端调用 System One 的 Choice/Noul/Score；代码把低确定性结果交回 Agent，作者设备与准确率示例未由本站复测。
summary.en: An MCP/CLI decision service for coding agents with a TypeSafe Jev System One backend for Choice/Noul/Score; low-certainty results return to the agent. Hardware and accuracy examples are author-reported.

summary.zh: 本地 Agent 记忆库的可选 Jev 重排器：一次请求给最多 40 条候选记忆分别打 Noul 相关性分，失败退回本地交叉编码器；作者排名评测未证明最终回答改善。
summary.en: An optional Jev reranker for a local agent memory store: one request scores up to 40 candidate memories with Nouls and falls back to a local cross-encoder. Author ranking tests do not establish better final answers.

summary.zh: Go 库及 CLI，默认连接 TypeSafe Jev，以 Choice/Noul/Score 对文本、文件或 diff 运行类型化判断；也支持 Jev 兼容服务，运行示例和速度为作者材料。
summary.en: A Go library and CLI that defaults to TypeSafe Jev for typed Choice/Noul/Score decisions over text, files, or diffs; it also supports compatible services. Demos and timing are author-provided.

summary.zh: 创作者素材研究工具：从字幕、画面文字、评论等证据构建帖子状态，Jev 按固定 rubric 评分后筛选候选，再交 Claude 解读；前端仍在计划中，本站未运行真实平台流程。
summary.en: A creator research tool that builds post evidence from transcripts, on-screen text, and comments, scores fixed rubrics with Jev, then sends a shortlist to Claude. The frontend remains planned; live platform flow was not reproduced.

summary.zh: Pi 编码 Agent 的记忆相关性扩展：对索引中每条记忆作 Noul 判断并给 Agent 排序提示，可用 OpenRouter Jev 或本地兼容 CLI；排序只是待核对线索。
summary.en: A Pi coding-agent memory relevance extension that scores each indexed memory with a Noul and gives the agent ranked hints, using hosted Jev through OpenRouter or a local compatible CLI; ranks need review.

summary.zh: X 书签与技术信息源摘要模板：可选 Jev 对公开正文作科技相关性 Noul 与主题 Choice，写入日常筛选数据；无 Jev key 时标 unavailable，由另一流程接手。
summary.en: An X bookmark and tech-source digest template with optional Jev Noul relevance and Choice topic decisions over public text; without a Jev key it records unavailable and uses another workflow.

summary.zh: 编码 Agent 编辑后触发的模糊规则检查：TypeSafe Jev 对团队规则作 Noul 违例判断并提示 Agent 修复；可选 Clef，失败放行，作者效果与成本未由本站复测。
summary.en: A post-edit fuzzy rule check for coding agents: TypeSafe Jev uses Nouls to flag team-rule violations for agent repair. Clef is optional, failures pass through, and author results and costs were not reproduced.

summary.zh: 已合并的 PR #29818 为 Laya、Julia-1、Lev、OpenJev、Kev 加入 `/v1/systemone` 兼容 API 和 Choice/Noul/Score 概率输出；这是替代模型基础设施，不提供 TypeSafe Jev 权重。
summary.en: Merged PR #29818 adds a compatible `/v1/systemone` API and Choice/Noul/Score probabilities for Laya, Julia-1, Lev, OpenJev, and Kev. This is alternative-model infrastructure, not TypeSafe Jev weights.

summary.zh: 编码 Agent 的 System One 工具箱：CLI、网关与类型化客户端可选托管 Jev 检查 diff 和完成声明；须显式启用，外发内容应先预览。
summary.en: A System One toolkit for coding agents with a CLI, gateway, and typed client; hosted Jev can check diffs and completion claims when explicitly enabled. Preview outbound content.

summary.zh: 思源 AI 工具调用审批插件：Jev 判断授权、影响与待审内容的自授权文字，代码再按阈值批准、拒绝或交人工；不构成安全保证。
summary.en: A SiYuan AI tool-call review plugin: Jev assesses authorization, impact, and self-authorizing text; code thresholds then approve, deny, or ask the user. It is not a security guarantee.

summary.zh: 七种棋类对弈站：Jev 给合法着法 Choice 概率，确定性战术层可接管后续走子；另有 mock、随机与 Rapfi 渠道，作者战绩未由本站复跑。
summary.en: A seven-game board-play site where Jev scores legal moves with Choice probabilities and a deterministic tactics layer can override them. Mock, random, and Rapfi modes also exist; results were not reproduced.

summary.zh: Factorio 宏观决策 Agent：Jev 对目标、下一动作、卡住状态和紧急度作 Choice/Noul/Score 判断，代码过滤非法动作并在低置信度时回退；离线 mock 并非 Jev 实测。
summary.en: A Factorio macro-decision agent: Jev answers Choice/Noul/Score questions on goals, next actions, stuck state, and urgency; code filters impossible actions and falls back on low confidence. Offline mock is not Jev inference.

summary.zh: Oracle PL/SQL 的 Jev 兼容扩展：把行 JSON 批量发往 System One，提供真假、概率、分类和评分函数；需网络 ACL 与 HTTPS wallet，行数据会离开数据库。
summary.en: An Oracle PL/SQL Jev-compatible extension batching row JSON to System One for boolean, probability, choice, and score functions. It needs a network ACL and HTTPS wallet; row data leaves the database.

summary.zh: Agent 封闭判断评测库：公开 450 条作者标注样本和规则基线，实际调用 Jev 对路由、完成核验、浏览动作等任务评分；实验结果未经本站复核。
summary.en: An agent decision benchmark with 450 author-labelled items and a rules baseline; it calls Jev for routing, completion checks, browser-action risk, and more. Reported results were not reproduced here.

summary.zh: 非官方 Java 26 Jev SDK：提供 System One 的 Noul/Choice/Score 类型化客户端、重试和虚拟线程，并附离线工单样例；结构化并发模块需预览特性。
summary.en: An unofficial Java 26 Jev SDK with a typed System One client, retries, virtual threads, and an offline ticket sample; its structured-concurrency module requires preview features.

summary.zh: 通用 Jev 重排库：一批最多 30 篇候选文档，每篇一个 Noul 相关性概率，按分数重排或阈值裁剪；BEIR 效果为作者报告，本站未复测。
summary.en: A Jev reranking library asking one Noul per candidate in batches of up to 30, then sorting or pruning by probability. BEIR results are author-reported and unverified here.

summary.zh: Spring AI 社区的 TypeSafe Java 客户端及扩展：有类型化 System One、JevJudge、回答纠正 advisor、RAG 与工具检索；不是 TypeSafe 官方 SDK，托管调用与示例质量未经本站复测。
summary.en: A Spring AI community TypeSafe Java client and integrations for typed System One, JevJudge, response-refinement advisors, RAG, and tool search. It is not a TypeSafe first-party SDK; hosted calls and sample quality were not reproduced here.

summary.zh: Magic: The Gathering 引擎的 Jev AI 对手：本地开发模式将玩家视角与合法动作送给 OpenRouter Choice，引擎校验并可纠正或回退；不代表完整规则覆盖或独立获胜率证明。
summary.en: A Jev opponent in a Magic: The Gathering engine: local development mode sends a player view and legal actions to OpenRouter Choice, then validates, corrects, or falls back. This does not establish complete rules coverage or independently measured win rates.

summary.zh: OpenInference 中的 TypeSafe Python/JS 自动追踪子包：包装 System One 调用并导出 DECISION spans、模型与 token usage；可屏蔽输入输出，默认追踪内容需评估隐私。stars 属于父仓库。
summary.en: OpenInference TypeSafe Python/JS instrumentation wraps System One calls and exports DECISION spans, model identity, and token usage. Input/output masking is available; default payload tracing needs privacy review. Stars belong to the parent repository.

summary.zh: Convex 的决策模型评测扩展：发布问题库与可执行证据，实际调用 Jev 原生问题并保留概率、成本和模型身份；部分题目在干净环境的重放仍待补齐，本站未重跑。
summary.en: Convex decision-model evaluations publish a question bank and executable evidence, call native Jev questions, and retain probabilities, costs, and model identity. Some clean-environment replay remains incomplete; this site did not rerun the benchmark.

summary.zh: OpenCode 工具结果裁剪插件：Jev 根据当前任务选择应保留的输出行，超大结果先由代码预筛；不可用或不确定时保留原输出，文本可能发外部，作者效果未复测。
summary.en: An OpenCode tool-output trimming plugin: Jev chooses relevant lines using task context, with code prefiltering oversized results. Unavailable or uncertain decisions preserve output; text may leave the device, and author results were not reproduced.

summary.zh: OpenCode 的逐提示推理强度插件：Jev 对当前与近期请求及上轮概览评分，再由代码调整 effort；超时或失败保持级别，本站未验证省量或答案质量。
summary.en: An OpenCode per-prompt effort plugin: Jev scores current and recent requests plus a prior-run summary, and code adjusts effort. Timeout or failure holds the level; token savings and answer quality were not verified here.

summary.zh: Claude Code mod 用 OpenRouter Jev Score 映射 low/medium/high/xhigh；默认 shadow 只记日志，显式关闭才改推理强度，近期对话会送外部，作者环境未由本站复现。
summary.en: A Claude Code mod maps OpenRouter Jev Score to low/medium/high/xhigh effort. Shadow mode logs only by default; explicit activation changes effort. Recent conversation text leaves the device, and author runs were not reproduced.

summary.zh: Rust 控制循环库：把 Datadog 遥测和可选 Toto 预测转成类型化状态，Jev 提议 Open/Probe/NoChange；代码在执行时检查状态版本、数据时效、冷却与探测约束。仓库提供熔断模拟器，本站未复现生产效果。
summary.en: Rust control-loop library using Datadog telemetry and optional Toto forecasts. Jev recommends Open/Probe/NoChange; code checks revisions, freshness, cooldowns and probe constraints before applying transitions. Includes a circuit-breaker simulator; production outcomes were not reproduced here.

summary.zh: Prometheus Alertmanager 通知中继：Jev 对告警描述做有限分类，附加 incident/routine/review 标记并保留每条原始通知；低置信度、截断或 API 失败转人工复核，下游发送失败返回 503。作者只用合成输入测试 API，未接真实 Alertmanager。
summary.en: Prometheus Alertmanager relay that adds finite Jev triage annotations while forwarding every original notification. Low confidence, truncation or API failures become review; downstream failures return HTTP 503. The author exercised the API with synthetic input, without a live Alertmanager instance.

summary.zh: TypeSafe 官方文档、demo 与 cookbook 素材库，包含公开数据夹具和 Python 函数调度代码：用 Choice/Noul 选函数及有限参数，再由代码执行。交易图表示例使用合成行情；不是独立完整安装包，本站未运行。
summary.en: Official documentation, demo and cookbook materials, with public fixtures and Python dispatch code that uses Choice/Noul for functions and finite arguments before code executes them. Trading charts use synthetic bars; this is not a complete standalone package and was not run here.

summary.zh: 用 WordNet 预测键盘给 Jev 有限词、字母、标点和结束选项，再由代码逐键拼句；有转录、回删防循环与步数预算。实验项目，本站未复现答题或辅助沟通效果。
summary.en: Experimental predictive keyboard: Jev selects finite words, letters, punctuation and stop keys while code composes text. Includes transcripts, backspace-loop controls and a step budget; answer quality and assistive use were not reproduced here.

summary.zh: 矿车轨道解谜：玩家句子一次触发所有开关的 Choice/Noul/Score，服务端代码模拟路线并评分。提供五关、参考答案与回放测试；作者调用/延迟数据未经本站实测。
summary.en: Mine-cart puzzle where one player sentence drives batched Choice/Noul/Score switches, then backend code simulates and scores the route. Includes five levels, reference solutions and replay tests; author API and timing results were not independently measured.

summary.zh: 个人 AI 信息简报：真实 Jev 后端用批量 Score 筛选单条信息、Noul 门控来源，再交 LLM 生成双语报告；失败或低置信度保留候选。包含独立 mock 路径，本站未验证节省量或信息召回。
summary.en: Personal AI digest with a real Jev backend: batched Scores filter items and Nouls gate sources before LLM report generation. Failed or uncertain items are retained, with a separate mock path. Token savings and information recall were not validated here.

summary.zh: Discord 审核机器人：规则与 Jev 上下文分类结合，默认 Observe，低置信度转人工复核；策略可告警、删帖和超时，不自动封禁。需自有 Discord/Cloudflare/TypeSafe 配置，本站未连接真实服务器。
summary.en: Discord moderation bot combining rules and Jev context classification. Starts in Observe, sends uncertain detections to review and can warn, delete or time out under configured policies, without automatic bans. Requires Discord/Cloudflare/TypeSafe setup; no live server was tested here.

summary.zh: Pi 的 Jev 虚拟模型路由器：按工作阶段选后端与 effort，首次文件修改后按策略切换到实现模型，分类失败或不确定回退 planning。需 OpenRouter 与相关 Pi/Cursor SDK，本站未验证模型账号或缓存收益。
summary.en: Jev-backed virtual router for Pi that selects backend models and effort by work phase, hands off after a file mutation and falls back to planning on classification failure or uncertainty. Requires OpenRouter and Pi/Cursor integration; account compatibility and cache benefits were not tested here.

summary.zh: 六个可移植决策 Skill 与 Python CLI，覆盖输入护栏、模型路由、重排、工具门控、置信度和输出评价；Jev/OpenRouter 适配器验证有类型响应，只返回建议。作者说明初始阈值未校准，测试与费用为作者记录。
summary.en: Six portable decision skills and a Python CLI for guardrails, routing, reranking, tool gating, confidence gates and output evaluation. The Jev/OpenRouter adapter validates typed responses and returns recommendations only. Initial thresholds are uncalibrated; test and cost evidence is the author’s.

summary.zh: 非官方 Jev 开发 Skill：用有界问题、置信度与代码执行边界解释设计模式，附代码草图和社区项目参考。独立于 TypeSafe 官方 Skill，本站未安装或运行作者评测。
summary.en: Unofficial Jev development skill covering bounded questions, confidence handling and code-owned workflows, with pattern sketches and community references. Separate from TypeSafe’s official skill; installation and author evaluations were not run here.

summary.zh: 本地交易分类原型：Vercel AI Gateway 的 Jev Choice 对固定示例账户分类，概率低于 0.85、缺概率或错误均保留 Unassigned 供复核，再导出 CSV。仅合成演示，没有数据库或记账系统接线，本站未核账。
summary.en: Local transaction-classification prototype using Jev Choices through Vercel AI Gateway. Low, missing or invalid probabilities retain Unassigned for review before CSV export. Synthetic demonstration only, without database or accounting-system integration; accounting outcomes were not validated here.

summary.zh: 自然语言地图探索：Jev 先判断场所类型，再批量判断地点与街道匹配度，代码结合 OSM/Mapillary 数据、硬约束和概率高亮地图。可选本地 Shingi 独立后端，作者演示/速度与成本非本站实测。
summary.en: Natural-language map exploration: Jev judges place types, then batches place and street relevance while code combines OSM/Mapillary data, hard constraints and probabilities to highlight matches. Supports a separate local Shingi backend; author demos, speed and cost were not independently measured.

summary.zh: Python 语义文本库：候选原文片段由 Jev 有类型判断后用于查找、提取、替换、分割与排序，保留偏移量及不确定/错误结果。支持多后端、缓存与回放；原文切片不保证语义匹配正确，本站未验证脱敏效果。
summary.en: Python semantic text library using typed Jev judgments over candidate source spans for finding, extraction, replacement, splitting and ranking, retaining offsets and uncertain/error outcomes. Includes multiple backends, caching and replay; verbatim spans do not guarantee correct semantic matches or redaction.

summary.zh: 技术栈感知的 CVE 信息工具：JeV 通过 Workers AI 判描述环境、候选产品适配和外网暴露，固定代码匹配漏洞并用公开利用信号排序；故障保留基础解析。栈保存在可分享 URL，本站未验漏洞覆盖或风险校准。
summary.en: Stack-aware CVE tool using Jev on Workers AI for environment, product-fit and internet-exposure judgments. Fixed code matches vulnerabilities and ranks public exploitation signals, retaining base parsing on model failure. Stack URLs are shareable; coverage and risk calibration were not validated here.

summary.zh: 工业产品手册选型 pilot：比较 Jev 结构化判断、RAG、抓取、LLM 与规则基线，公开评测与证据接口。代码 MIT、数据 CC BY 4.0；仅 12 个 held-out 任务、gold 非人类专家核验，作者承认低正确率和错误批准，非成熟选型方案。
summary.en: Pilot comparing structured Jev selection, RAG, scraping, LLM and rules over industrial manuals, with evaluation and evidence interfaces. MIT code and CC BY 4.0 data; only 12 held-out tasks with non-expert gold labels. The author reports low correctness and false approvals; this is not a mature selection system.

summary.zh: 社区 TypeScript 多提供商库，在生成/流式接口之外提供 typed decide；TypeSafe/Jev 支持直连和 Vercel Gateway，校验 Choice/Score/Noul 响应并返回调用方处理。无配置可降级，作者生产与费用数字未由本站验证。
summary.en: Community TypeScript library adding typed decide alongside generation and streaming, with direct TypeSafe/Jev and Vercel Gateway transports. Parses Choice/Score/Noul responses for application handling and can degrade without configuration. Author production and cost claims were not verified here.

summary.zh: 非官方 Jev Notebook 教程库：规划 60 项，核验快照已发布 5 个；共享 fixture、回放与显式 live SDK 后端，记录模式和返回模型。社区教程独立于官方 18 篇 cookbook，合成指标不当真实 Jev 效果，本站未运行。
summary.en: Unofficial Jev notebook curriculum planning 60 recipes, with five published in the reviewed snapshot. Shares fixture, replay and explicit live SDK backends with mode/model provenance. Separate from the 18 official cookbooks; synthetic metrics are not live Jev results and notebooks were not run here.

summary.zh: Laravel/Filament 自然语言表格过滤器：Jev Noul 批量评分 SQL 已筛选行，缓存结果并按可配置阈值显示，未评分行过多会先确认。MIT 插件，作者性能/成本未由本站复现。
summary.en: Laravel/Filament natural-language table filter using batched Jev Nouls over SQL-filtered rows, caching scores and applying a configurable threshold, with confirmation for large unscored sets. MIT plugin; author performance and cost were not reproduced.

summary.zh: README 声明核验原型：经 Glasser 调用 Jev 做类别与候选名称 Choice，置信度门槛后用代码核验依赖、命令、环境变量和引用。新加入真实 scan/eval，完整浏览器扩展与网页仍在开发；本站未运行付费评测。
summary.en: README claim-verification prototype using Jev via Glasser for claim-type and candidate-name Choices before confidence gates and deterministic dependency, command, environment-variable and reference checks. Live scan/evaluation modules now exist; the full extension/web app is still in development and paid evaluations were not run here.

summary.zh: MuJoCo 视觉追逐仿真：结构化状态经有限动作决策交给确定性控制器。默认 NeoHorse-Jev-4B 是独立模型，当前单追逐者/单目标，多机协同为计划；不是 TypeSafe Jev 开源权重或真实硬件验收。
summary.en: MuJoCo visual pursuit simulation passing bounded action decisions over structured state to deterministic controllers. Defaults to the separate NeoHorse-Jev-4B model; the current setup has one pursuer and one target, with multi-agent coordination planned. Not TypeSafe Jev open weights or real-hardware validation.

summary.zh: ChronoDivide 单人对战实验：确定性游戏逻辑结合 System One 兼容判断与审计回放。当前默认本地 clef-flash，托管 Jev 可配置；现有比赛不可当 Jev 实测，本站未运行。
summary.en: ChronoDivide single-player experiment combining deterministic game logic with System One-compatible judgments and audit/replay. Defaults to local clef-flash, with configurable hosted Jev; current matches are not Jev measurements and were not run here.

summary.zh: Chrome 内容手法提示扩展：经用户许可的可见正文由 Jev 批量 Noul 判断，按阈值加提示，展示原问题和概率；有缓存、正文长度与日预算限制。概率描述写法而非事实真伪，启用站点正文会发往模型后端；本站未安装或复测。
summary.en: Chrome extension using batched Jev Nouls over visible text on permitted sites to show thresholded writing-technique cues, original questions and probabilities, with caching, text limits and daily budgets. Probabilities concern wording, not factual truth; enabled-site text goes to the model backend. Not installed or reproduced here.

summary.zh: 家庭负载调度原型：Jev 分类家电并评分重要度，代码负责紧迫性、时限与容量等硬约束和优化；低置信度或未配置会标明 heuristic/mixed。碳强度为代理估计，不能声称已测真实设备减排。
summary.en: Household load-scheduling prototype using Jev appliance classification and importance scores while code handles urgency, deadlines, capacity constraints and optimization. Low-confidence or unconfigured paths explicitly label heuristic/mixed results. Carbon intensity is a proxy estimate, not measured device emissions savings.

summary.zh: MCP 工具发现基准：比较 Jev Choice 平面/分层路由、弃权与其他模型及检索基线，输出报告。只测路由，不证明工具执行或 Agent 成功率；gold 由编码助手选择，作者速度、费用和准确率未由本站复现。
summary.en: MCP tool-discovery benchmark comparing flat/factored/hierarchical Jev Choice routing and abstention with other models and retrieval baselines. Reports routing performance without proving tool execution or agent success; gold tools were selected by coding assistants, and author timing, costs and accuracy were not reproduced.

summary.zh: Pi Agent 的 Jev 会话压缩实验扩展：工具调用/结果各问一个 Noul，按概率保留或裁剪，接入压缩 hook、输出预算与默认摘要回退。package.json 声明 MIT，未附独立 LICENSE；算法来源 fast-jev-compaction，作者保真/节省数据未复现。
summary.en: Experimental Jev compaction extension for Pi Agent, judging tool calls/results with two Nouls before keeping or trimming, with compaction hooks, output budgets and default-summary fallback. package.json declares MIT without a standalone LICENSE; derives from fast-jev-compaction and author retention/savings were not reproduced.

summary.zh: 社区 TypeScript System One 工具库与流程型服务 Agent：Jev 读取有限意图、菜单/槽位与确认，代码负责门槛、工具调用和模板回复。披萨店提供 real/fake/replay 路径与模拟收银台；alpha，未接真实支付/厨房，非官方 SDK。
summary.en: Community TypeScript System One toolkit and procedural service agent using Jev for bounded intents, menu/slot values and confirmations, while code owns gates, tool calls and templated replies. Pizza demo distinguishes live/fake/replay and uses a simulated register; alpha, without real payment/kitchen integration, and not an official SDK.

summary.zh: GitHub Action 为 Issues/PR 分类，只添加既有标签；Jev Noul/Choice 经概率、胜出差距与快照回读门槛，不执行提交者代码。支持 TypeSafe/OpenRouter 与另一独立模型；作者未 live 验证质量，24 例不当校准证据。
summary.en: GitHub Action classifying Issues/PRs and adding existing labels only, with Jev Noul/Choice probability, margin and fresh-snapshot gates, without executing contributor code. Supports TypeSafe/OpenRouter and a separate model; author quality is not live-verified and 24 examples do not establish calibration.

summary.zh: Dependabot/Renovate 更新分流：Jev 判断发布说明、代码用法、CI 与风险，配置策略决定 auto-merge、人工复核或 hold，再写 GitHub 评论/标签与可选通知。可用规则/LLM 基线；作者评测不构成本站验证的安全合并保证。
summary.en: Dependabot/Renovate gate using Jev over release notes, code usage, CI and risk before configurable auto-merge, review or hold policies and GitHub comments/labels with optional notifications. Includes rule/LLM baselines; author evaluations are not an independently verified safe-merge guarantee.

summary.zh: Go CLI 按目标用 Jev Noul 筛网页、文件块或列表项，保留原文行号与输入格式。分批、并发和部分失败标记可查；未判项默认保留，但上限可能再裁剪，全失败报错。重要信息可能漏选，本站未测召回或 token 节省。
summary.en: Go CLI filtering web/file chunks or list items with goal-based Jev Nouls, preserving source line ranges and input format. Includes batching, concurrency and partial-error markers; unjudged items are kept by default but caps can trim them, and total failure reports an error. Recall and token savings were not validated here.

summary.zh: Rust 编码 Agent runtime 的可选 Jev 决策层：任务只在已配置、授权的模型/推理强度中做 Choice，默认关闭；响应校验与重编译不通过即保留原模型。实际 TypeSafe 适配器与主流程接线已核对，本站未运行或验证任务质量/费用。
summary.en: Optional Jev decision layer in a Rust coding-agent runtime, choosing only among configured authorized models/efforts and disabled by default. Invalid responses or failed plan recompilation retain the configured model. TypeSafe adapter and runtime wiring were inspected without running it or validating task quality/cost.

summary.zh: ego lite 的多步浏览器决策层：Jev 选择有限动作、元素及调用方给定值，代码执行并复核要求。MIT，继承 jev-browser 部分代码；需 macOS/ego，作者24次配对样例不代表通用成功率，本站未运行。
summary.en: Multi-step decision layer for ego lite: Jev selects bounded actions, elements and caller-provided values, while code acts and rechecks requirements. MIT with inherited jev-browser code; requires macOS/ego. Author paired examples are not general reliability and were not run here.

summary.zh: Embabel/Dice 城市出游原型，Jev 在代码生成的暂定计划与补查选项中做有类型判断；默认本地规则，另支持 OpenAI/Clef。地图、官网线索及偏好记忆有独立同意与未知标记，不预订；Snapshot依赖和作者观察未由本站运行复现。
summary.en: Embabel/Dice city-outing prototype using typed Jev judgments over code-generated tentative plans and a research option. Defaults to local rules with OpenAI/Clef alternatives. Map/site clues and preference memory expose consent and unknowns, without bookings; snapshot dependencies and author observations were not reproduced.

summary.zh: 社区 Elixir System One 客户端：TypeSafe/OpenRouter Jev、独立 Clef 和兼容后端，返回 Choice/Noul/Score 完整分布；真实 Req HTTP 与 Stub 分开，重试/错误 tuple/脱敏遥测可查。Apache-2.0，非官方 SDK，本站未运行。
summary.en: Community Elixir System One client returning full Choice/Noul/Score distributions for TypeSafe/OpenRouter Jev, separate Clef and compatible providers. Distinguishes real Req HTTP from Stub, with retries, error tuples and telemetry excluding request content. Apache-2.0, unofficial and not run here.

summary.zh: 已结算预测市场的 Jev 回溯评测：对比盲文本/带历史价格的 Noul 与类别 Choice，代码生成校准和市场价基线报告。MIT；训练知识、时点与类别混杂需考虑，纸面结果不证明前瞻交易收益，原始模型结果未提交，本站未复现。
summary.en: Retrospective Jev evaluation over resolved prediction markets, comparing blind/priced Nouls and category Choices with calibration and market-price baselines. MIT; training knowledge, timing and category confounds remain. Paper results do not prove prospective trading returns; raw model answers are uncommitted and were not reproduced.

summary.zh: 两阶段邮件分诊：Jev 先分类，再选有限语气/回复意图；代码返回归档、静音、人工或草稿建议信号。MIT，Python/jevlang 示例，没有实际邮箱连接、正文生成或自动发信；阈值未由本站校准。
summary.en: Two-stage email triage: Jev classifies, then selects bounded tone/reply intent; code returns archive, mute, human-review or draft signals. MIT, Python/jevlang example without mailbox integration, prose generation or sending. Thresholds were not calibrated here.

summary.zh: 源自 fazlerocks/jevmail 的 MIT Gmail 分诊原型，Workers AI/Command Code 的 Jev 适配、持久化纠错与托盘规则可查。合成夹具可用；作者明确真实 Gmail/部署未验收，当前 deploy 不发布 PWA，没有完整自托管安装或自动归档/发信。本站未运行。
summary.en: MIT Gmail-triage prototype derived from fazlerocks/jevmail, with inspectable Workers AI/Command Code Jev adapters, persistent corrections and tray rules. Synthetic fixtures work; the author explicitly reports no real Gmail/deployment acceptance and deploy omits the PWA. No complete self-hosting or automatic filing/sending; not run here.

summary.zh: MIT Alertmanager→Discord 实验接收器：脱敏摘要经 Jev Choice 决定紧急/普通频道，Score 只日志；缺 key/低置信/超时回严重标签规则，恢复通知沿用原频道。Sticky 仅内存，不宜作为唯一关键告警通道；本站未部署或发通知。
summary.en: MIT experimental Alertmanager-to-Discord receiver: scrubbed summaries feed a Jev Choice for urgent/info channels, with a logged-only Score. Missing keys, low confidence and timeouts fall back to severity labels; resolutions reuse the channel. Sticky state is in memory, unsuitable as the only critical-alert path; not deployed here.

summary.zh: MIT Mineflayer 游戏实验：代码构造可行动作菜单和生存/食物/工作竞争，Jev 判断后执行并记录失败。多数问题在 API 不可用时等待，身体物理问题有例外；作者仍未通关，成本、延迟与试验成绩非本站复现，固定 SHA 源码优先于旧 README 描述。
summary.en: MIT Mineflayer game experiment: code builds feasible action menus and survival/food/work claims for Jev to judge, then acts and records failures. Most questions wait during outages, with bodily-physics exceptions. The author has not beaten the game; costs, timing and trials were not reproduced, and pinned source takes precedence over older README descriptions.

summary.zh: GPL-3.0-only Windows 技术排障评估应用，另一模型构造状态，Jev 选故障域/下一步并判断诊断、修复与解决证据，代码加生命周期/前提约束。官方 TypeSafe 和自定义网关分开；SQLCipher 离线测试不证明真实模型效果或全面安全，非自动设备修复，本站未运行。
summary.en: GPL-3.0-only Windows troubleshooting evaluation app: another model builds state, Jev chooses fault domain/next action and judges diagnosis, remediation and resolution evidence, with coded lifecycle/prerequisite guards. Official TypeSafe and custom gateways are distinct. Offline SQLCipher tests do not prove live-model quality or comprehensive security; no automatic device repair and not run here.

summary.zh: Apache-2.0 求职者简历自查 CLI/MCP：Jev 返回岗位匹配与经验缺口等有限信号，代码生成加权分和要求覆盖证据。带合成回放；作者误差参照生成模型、速度/成本未复现，不是客观能力或录用准确率，也不自动作招聘决定。
summary.en: Apache-2.0 resume self-check CLI/MCP: Jev provides bounded role-match and experience-gap signals for weighted scores and requirement-coverage evidence. Includes synthetic replay; author errors use a generative-model reference and costs/timing were not reproduced. Scores are not objective ability or hiring accuracy and do not make hiring decisions.

summary.zh: MIT 抓取信号研究平台，Jev Noul 筛掉低相关性、排序待扫描结果，Grok/规则负责提取，安全扫描和人工判断独立。源码可查但代币、交易与收益宣传非本站认可；进程内预算及作者延迟/费用未复现，本站未抓取、连钱包或运行。
summary.en: MIT crawler-signal research platform using Jev Nouls to filter low relevance and prioritize scans, with Grok/rules for extraction and separate scanning/human judgment. Inspectable code does not validate token, trading or profit claims. Process-local budgets and author costs/timing were not reproduced; no crawling, wallet connection or execution here.

summary.zh: MIT 相关规则引擎，把已记录的 Jev 判断和业务事实映射为可测试、可版本化的处理标签，并比较阈值变更影响。示例 trace 不实际退款；实时 OpenRouter 地址未确认与官方当前接口兼容，部分缺字段填0，不称全面验证或线上可用。本站未运行。
summary.en: MIT related rule engine mapping recorded Jev judgments and business facts to tested, versioned outcome labels and threshold-change comparisons. Example trace does not issue refunds; its live OpenRouter URL is not confirmed against the current official API, and some missing fields default to zero. No comprehensive validation or live readiness is claimed; not run here.

summary.zh: MIT 搜索意图相关性研究应用：Jev Score 分别评意图与预设词，代码生成乘积分和重复答案噪声带，浏览器 IndexedDB 保存结果。文本仍送模型，±2SD 不是排名/真值准确率校准；作者100次重复实验未复现，本站未安装或测生产页面。
summary.en: MIT search-intent relevance research app: Jev Scores judge intent and expected terms, with coded product scores and repeat-answer noise bands stored in browser IndexedDB. Text still reaches the model, and ±2 SD does not calibrate rankings or truth. Author 100-run experiments were not reproduced; no installation or production-page evaluation here.

summary.zh: MIT 韩文情境回应练习，Jev 判断接受/暂缓/拒绝并评分、检查情境标准，代码按各情境基准计通过与报告；生成场景/总评另用编码助手。模拟量表不是实际顾客反应或员工能力认证，回复送OpenRouter，移动/Windows及进度保存有限，本站未运行。
summary.en: MIT Korean scenario-response practice: Jev selects accept/defer/decline and scores/checks scenario rubrics, while code computes passes and reports against local baselines. Coding assistants generate scenarios/overall comments. Simulated scales are not actual customer reactions or employee certification; replies reach OpenRouter, with mobile/Windows/persistence limits. Not run here.

summary.zh: MIT 动作级间接提示注入研究检查：Jev 同时读请求、工具结果及待执行动作，双条件标记；只返回flag/readable与概率，不拦截。默认动作400字符/正文6000，已知填充绕过；公开攻击集和作者检测率未复现，不是安全保证，本站未运行。
summary.en: MIT act-level indirect-injection research check using Jev over requests, tool output and a proposed act, with a two-condition flag. Returns flags/readability/probabilities without blocking. Default 400-character acts and 6,000-character content have known padding bypasses. Public attack-set results were not reproduced and are not a security guarantee; not run here.

summary.zh: MIT 技术写作风格研究工具，Jev 对逐句风格问题做 Noul，代码算每千词密度、区间及13篇人类技术文基线；实验改写另用生成模型。风格指标不能鉴定作者或事实质量，Node26与API另需配置，作者效果/费用未由本站复现。
summary.en: MIT technical-writing style research tool using per-sentence Jev Nouls for density, intervals and a 13-post human baseline; experimental editing uses generative models separately. Style metrics do not identify authorship or factual quality. Requires Node 26/API configuration; author quality/cost claims were not reproduced here.

summary.zh: MIT DuckDB 决策扩展，把 SQL 行文本/JSON 经显式启用的 TypeSafe Jev 映射成概率、选项、分值及分布；另有本地模型与明确标注常数 Stub。注册/配置按进程重建，托管文本会发提供商，安装渠道签名/版本有区别，概率与可选校准需自测；本站未安装或运行。
summary.en: MIT DuckDB decision extension mapping SQL text/JSON through explicitly enabled TypeSafe Jev into probabilities, choices, scores and distributions. Also supports local models and a clearly constant Stub. Registrations/settings are process-local, hosted text reaches providers and installation channels differ in signing/version. Probabilities/optional calibration need local evaluation; not installed or run here.

summary.zh: MIT 社区 Go 有类型决策层，显式选择 TypeSafe Jev/Clef，返回所请求与实际响应模型标识；凭据由调用方传入，每 Call 单次 POST、不跟随重定向，校验响应边界。零第三方运行依赖，不代表模型判断或部署已经验证；本站未运行，基础工单示例不另列案例。
summary.en: MIT community Go typed decision layer with explicit TypeSafe Jev/Clef selection and requested/resolved model records. Callers supply credentials; each Call makes one POST without redirect following, with response bounds. No third-party runtime dependencies, without proof of model quality or deployment; not run here and the basic ticket example is not duplicated as a case.

summary.zh: MIT pre-alpha 自然语言+TypeScript 浏览器测试，默认 Jev 选有限元素并判断页面主张，Playwright 执行；带新鲜性检查、概率与矛盾 flag，CI退出策略独立。边缘分数可 passed+flag，不能把 flag 当硬失败；Clef另选，作者节省/速度未复现，本站未测试第三方站点。
summary.en: MIT pre-alpha natural-language/TypeScript browser tests using Jev by default for bounded element selection and page claims, with Playwright execution, freshness checks and probability/contradiction flags. CI exit policy is separate; marginal results may pass with flags. Clef is optional; author savings/timing were not reproduced and no third-party sites were tested here.

summary.zh: MIT iOS Simulator 研究控制器，对比辅助功能树、截图网格与 Jev1.14 Box；存在/置信与新鲜性门控后经 AXe 操作，结果验收另读持久化状态。合成 FocusBench 与少量作者录像不代表通用App准确率，Box另给目标目录；需macOS/Xcode/AXe，实验视觉API，本站未运行。
summary.en: MIT iOS Simulator research controller comparing accessibility, screenshot grids and Jev 1.14 Boxes, gating presence/confidence/freshness before AXe actions and separately checking persisted outcomes. Synthetic FocusBench and a few author recordings do not establish general app accuracy; Box receives an extra target catalog. Requires macOS/Xcode/AXe and experimental vision APIs; not run here.

summary.zh: MIT 有界转换/规划工具，Jev 解释后用户复核、代码执行；Mermaid分支关系、列映射、日期等都用有限选择，Worker校验答案。源码与fixture测试不证明生产部署或真实推理质量；速率约束非精确全局花费帽，提交文本送TypeSafe，本站未运行。
summary.en: MIT bounded conversion/planning utilities where Jev interpretation is reviewed before coded execution. Diagram branches, column maps, dates and other tasks use finite choices validated by a Worker. Source/fixture tests do not prove production deployment or live quality; rate controls are not exact global spend caps and submitted text reaches TypeSafe. Not run here.

summary.zh: MIT Pi 上下文整理包，移植 fast-jev-compaction 的双Noul算法，通过 ComChatX 本机代理提出 context_edit；保留用户/助手文本，释放不足25%或失败不提案，原会话仍存。依赖平台代理，非独立Jev客户端，相关上下文会发模型；本站未运行，案例意义与已收录压缩算法重复。
summary.en: MIT Pi context-tidying package porting fast-jev-compaction two-Noul logic through a ComChatX loopback proxy to propose context_edit entries. User/assistant prose and original sessions remain; under-25% savings or failure proposes nothing. Requires that platform proxy and sends relevant context to the model. Not run here; its case meaning duplicates an existing compaction entry.

summary.zh: MIT Jev1.14图像异常研究与网站源码：先找区域、框完整语义单元，再分类/复核和显示定位。研究记录了裁剪切字、卡通与几何误报，v7b未重跑旧26图集；手选小样本和费用仅作者记录，不验证AI来源归因或生产准确率。图片送实验API，本站未上传/运行。
summary.en: MIT Jev 1.14 image-anomaly study and app source, discovering regions and framing whole semantic units before classification/confirmation and localization display. Documents cut-word, cartoon and geometry false flags; v7b did not rerun the old 26-image set. Small handpicked samples/costs are author reports, not AI-origin attribution or production accuracy. Images reach an experimental API; no uploads or execution here.

summary.zh: MIT 等距城市模拟，Jev 在代码给出的可行动作中选择，确定性规则控制移动、灾害与后果，并展示概率和来源。默认回放历史决策，实时模式另需密钥/口令/预算存储，失败显式退回规则；作者延迟与4902次有效响应不等于真实城市质量，本站未运行。
summary.en: MIT isometric city simulation where Jev selects code-defined feasible actions and deterministic rules govern movement, hazards and effects. Shows probabilities/provenance; recorded decisions are the default, while live mode needs credentials/passcode/budget storage and failures visibly fall back to rules. Author timing and 4,902 valid responses do not establish real-city quality; not run here.

summary.zh: TraceRoot 开源核心可用 Jev 的 Noul+Choice 检测 trace 并输出问题概率/类别；有投影预算、答案校验与错误结果。非ee部分Apache-2.0，任何ee目录商业许可；不把企业信号聚类混称开源。trace可能出机、截断会丢证据，SDK自动埋点另是功能，本站未部署或调用。
summary.en: TraceRoot open core can detect trace problems through Jev Noul/Choice questions with state budgets, response validation and error results. Non-ee content is Apache-2.0; all ee directories use a commercial license, including enterprise signal grouping. Traces may leave the machine and truncation can omit evidence. SDK auto-instrumentation is separate; not deployed or called here.

summary.zh: MIT 社区 Jev 技能/Agent 集成，含路由、检索、选择和独立关闭的视觉影子评估。主线云端图像检查用实验header，记录封闭答案比较而不改变原工具结果；截图不可自动脱敏，需明确启用。作者分支动作演示与主线shadow不同，本地Jev-Omni也非官方权重，本站未运行。
summary.en: MIT community Jev skills/agent integrations for routing, retrieval, choice and separately disabled vision shadow evaluation. Mainline cloud image checks use the experimental header and record bounded-answer comparisons without changing tool results; screenshots are not automatically redacted and need explicit opt-in. Author branch action demos and local Jev-Omni are separate, not official weights. Not run here.

summary.zh: MIT 研究工具，把批量Choice分类、Noul判断和两级原文定位作为RLM子调用，返回概率、offset及用量，供根模型代码计算。支持DSPy/自建循环，预算按估算限制Jev部分；根模型费用/执行权限另管。小样本单次结果仅作者自报，非生产库，本站未运行。
summary.en: MIT research tools exposing batched Choice classification, Noul judgments and two-stage original-text location as RLM sub-calls, returning probabilities, offsets and usage for root-model code. Supports DSPy/custom loops with estimated Jev-only spend limits; root costs and execution permissions are separate. Small single-run results are author reports, not a production library. Not run here.

summary.zh: MIT Rust grep重排工具：直连Jev对命中片段提Noul，代码校验、排序并输出原文路径/行号；非全库语义搜索。钉住主线已有搜索实现，但README仍说发布版仅密钥设置，不能据源码保证已发布包；网关兼容未验，文本会出机，本站未安装。
summary.en: MIT Rust grep reranker using direct Jev Nouls over matched snippets, validated and sorted in code with original paths/lines. Not full-corpus semantic retrieval. Pinned mainline implements search while the README still describes a key-setup-only release, so source is not proof of released packages. Gateway compatibility unverified; text leaves the machine. Not installed here.

summary.zh: MIT Jev+SenseLab业务决策研究集，以合成线索等比较固定政策、检索记忆和反馈记忆；模型选有限动作，程序模拟review、记忆更新和报告。不是实客分配、真实损失或Jev权重学习；错误选择首项并记error，外部服务需自备权限。作者效果未复现，本站未运行。
summary.en: MIT Jev/SenseLab decision experiments comparing fixed policy, retrieval memory and feedback memory on synthetic business streams. The model chooses bounded actions; code simulates review, memory updates and reports. Not real customer routing, real losses or Jev weight learning; errors choose the first action and carry an error field. External services need separate access. Author effects not reproduced; not run here.

summary.zh: MIT MV3浏览器屏蔽扩展，种子名单之外用Jev按域名/站点/资源类型与用户政策判断，编译为动态规则，用户覆盖优先。首请求可能放过、错误放行，响应回退解析宽松且费用是软帽；域名会发OpenRouter、外部名单另许可。Firefox未测，本站未安装或改变浏览器规则。
summary.en: MIT MV3 content blocker using Jev over host/site/resource type and user policy beyond seed lists, compiling dynamic rules with user overrides first. First requests may pass, errors fail open, parsing fallbacks are permissive and spend limits are soft. Host/site metadata reaches OpenRouter and external lists have separate licenses. Firefox untested; not installed or applied here.

summary.zh: MIT 语义规则检查器，默认Jev用Noul判源码偏离与scope，Choice定位段/行，代码按阈值形成可回看的报告/缓存。确定性规则仍交传统lint；概率和位置可能错，不自动修代码，源文件与附加上下文会出机。可换其他提供商，作者结果未复现，本站未运行。
summary.en: MIT semantic-rule checker using Jev by default for Noul violation/scope judgments and Choice section/line location, with thresholded reports and caches. Deterministic rules belong in conventional linters; probabilities/locations may be wrong, no automatic source fixes occur and source/context reaches providers. Other providers are separate; author results not reproduced and not run here.

summary.zh: MIT 决策模型对照评测源码与记录，1136文本题含相关变体，固定选项/版本与首次尝试，保留错误和成组诊断。主表19服务/全测22是作者呈现，格式失败剔除为事后规则；日期/路线限制速度比较，费用软帽、分数非本站实测，不另增应用案例。
summary.en: MIT decision-model comparison source and records over 1,136 text questions with related variants, fixed options/checkpoints, first attempts, errors and grouped diagnostics. The author presents 19 main-table services from 22 tested, with a post-hoc format-failure exclusion. Dates/routes limit speed comparisons, budgets are soft and scores are not site measurements; not duplicated as an application case.

summary.zh: MIT Python文本指标工具，Jev补有限词类、相关性、熟悉度和Score/体裁判断，本地算术/拟合组合形成指标和相对作者样本的复读提示；cadence本地独立。语料组件另许可，非通用写作质量裁判；原文出机、移动别名缓存可能过期，作者验证未复现，本站未安装。
summary.en: MIT Python prose metrics combining bounded Jev word-class/relatedness/familiarity and Score/genre judgments with local arithmetic/fitted models, flagging departures from author samples for rereading; cadence is separate and local. Data components carry separate licenses, not universal writing-quality judgments. Text reaches the provider and moving-alias caches may age. Author validation not reproduced; not installed here.

summary.zh: MIT jevlang多视角判断原型，三组安全/授权/攻击问题由代码汇总allow/human/block。demo只打印，不接真实执行器；CI使用假后端导入和lint，无live安全验收。三次同模型不同措辞不证明错误独立或权限成立，示例阈值需自测；本站未执行或调用。
summary.en: MIT jevlang multi-perspective prototype aggregating safety/authorization/attack questions into allow/human/block. The demo only prints, with no real executor; CI uses fake-backend imports and lint rather than live safety acceptance. Three framings of one model do not establish independent errors or authorization and example thresholds need evaluation. Not executed or called here.

summary.zh: MIT Windows/GSPro高尔夫模拟解说台，显式选择Jev时用实验图像/Box和Noul读小地图，代码几何/阈值生成事实及风险分支；解说/语音另由LLM/TTS生成。失败回退其他视觉，非现实球场安全导航，截图出机、模型与声音需自备；作者速度费用未复现，本站未运行。
summary.en: MIT Windows/GSPro simulator commentary booth optionally using experimental Jev images/Boxes/Nouls for minimap facts and coded geometry/threshold branches. LLM/TTS generate speech separately; failures fall back to another vision model. Not real-course safety navigation; screenshots leave the machine and models/voices require separate setup. Author timing/costs not reproduced; not run here.

summary.zh: MIT 的 Pi 内容/新文件放置检查扩展，真实 Noul 结果连接 edit/write 拦截；默认错误放行，不覆盖 bash，未运行模型。
summary.en: MIT Pi extensions for content and new-file placement, wiring Noul answers to edit/write blocking; errors allow by default, bash is outside scope, and no model was run.

summary.zh: MIT 的 OpenCode System One 插件，提供有界决策、推理级别/模型切换等接线；可显式设 TypeSafe endpoint，默认 Console 凭据/版本条件未独立验收。
summary.en: MIT OpenCode System One plugin with bounded judgments and reasoning/model switching; a TypeSafe endpoint can be explicit, while default Console credential/version conditions were not independently accepted.

summary.zh: Apache-2.0 编码 Agent 插件集；已核对 Pi 的 TypeSafe Noul 命令检查和拦截路径，分类器不可用时放行；不把供应商预设或八宿主支持声明当作本站实测。
summary.en: Apache-2.0 coding-agent plugins; the Pi TypeSafe Noul shell-check/blocking path was inspected and fails open when unavailable. Provider presets and eight-host support claims are not site-run tests.

summary.zh: 基于 fast-jev-compaction 的 MIT 隐私扩展分支，增加发给裁判前的密钥形状遮盖与可选稳定标识替换；云端仍可用真实 Jev，回放默认本地 Ollama。规则遮盖不保证完整保密，基础压缩案例已去重。
summary.en: MIT privacy-oriented derivative of fast-jev-compaction, adding secret-shape redaction and optional stable identifier substitution before judging. Cloud calls can use Jev; replay defaults to local Ollama. Pattern scrubbing is not a confidentiality guarantee; the base compaction case is deduplicated.

summary.zh: MIT 的有界决策/MCP 适配层，含真实 TypeSafe、图片与 Box 建议接线；默认离线 demo，视觉/桌面表面需启用，宿主保留权限与执行。仅列项目，不把建议原型写成已验收的桌面自动化案例。
summary.en: MIT bounded-decision/MCP adapter with TypeSafe, image, and Box advice wiring. The default is offline demo; vision/desktop surfaces are opt-in and the host retains permissions and execution. Listed as a project, not accepted desktop automation.

summary.zh: MIT 本地 AI 网关，已有 System One 请求/响应适配、Jev 意图与 effort 判断，以及决策模型组故障转移代码。可选其他裁判；仅核查源码，不把网关全部功能或作者性能声明当成 Jev 实测。
summary.en: MIT local AI gateway with System One request/response adaptation, Jev intent and effort judging, and decision-model group failover. Other judges are optional; source review does not establish Jev testing of every gateway feature or performance claim.

summary.zh: MIT 实时会议脑图工具，可用原生 Jev 判断新增发言含决定/TODO 的概率，再路由 Haiku/Sonnet 更新器。支持禁用或替换裁判；未录音或运行云服务，Jev 不生成脑图正文。
summary.en: MIT live meeting-mindmap tool using native Jev to judge decisions/action items in new remarks and route Haiku/Sonnet updaters. Judges can be disabled or replaced; no audio/cloud run was performed and Jev does not generate the mindmap prose.

summary.zh: 受 Jev 类型化决策接口启发的 MIT Linux 进程监控工具，默认运行本地 Laya/其他编码器与分类头，记录 safe/warn/crit 供人工查看。并非已核实的 TypeSafe Jev 调用或安全防护效果；代码许可不替代模型权重条款。
summary.en: MIT Linux process-monitoring tool inspired by Jev's typed-decision interface, using local Laya/other encoders and heads by default to record safe/warn/crit verdicts for review. Not verified TypeSafe Jev calls or security efficacy; code licensing does not replace model-weight terms.

summary.zh: MIT 记忆筛选适配器，先从本地 claude-mem 召回，再以原生 Jev Noul 和阈值筛选注入。默认最佳一条、失败不注入；提示词/摘要会离机，未安装钩子或读取用户记忆。
summary.en: MIT memory-selection adapter retrieving from local claude-mem before native Jev Nouls and threshold-gated injection. Defaults to one best record and no injection on failure; prompts/summaries leave the device. No hooks installed or user memories read.

summary.zh: MIT 的 PDF/PNG/JPEG 风险筛查 CLI 与库，原生 Jev 图像/元数据请求输出固定信号及 JSON 报告。不是欺诈鉴定，图像为实验功能且概率未校准；未上传文档或独立复测。
summary.en: MIT PDF/PNG/JPEG screening CLI and library using native Jev image/metadata requests for fixed signals and JSON reports. Not fraud determination; images are experimental and probabilities uncalibrated. No documents uploaded or independent reproduction performed.

summary.zh: MIT 社区演示合集，核实了商品图 Noul/Box 接线和三路规则评分，另有检索、裁判与本地模型对照工具。仅所列路径完成源码核查，非 TypeSafe 官方基准或生产政策保证。
summary.en: MIT community demo collection with reviewed listing-photo Noul/Box wiring and three-way rule scoring, alongside retrieval, judging, and local-model comparisons. Only the named paths were source-reviewed; not an official TypeSafe benchmark or production-policy guarantee.

summary.zh: MIT、基于 pi-loop 的源码开发版，用已配置的公开 jev_decide 工具建议配合固定验证器完成有界循环。需另配后端和 Pi 嵌套工具接口，仅 Pi 活跃时运行；真实模型/终端验收仍未证实，不收为已验证 Jev 端到端案例。
summary.en: MIT source development version derived from pi-loop, combining advice from a separately configured public jev_decide tool with a fixed verifier for bounded-loop completion. Requires a backend and Pi nested tools and runs while Pi is active; live-model/terminal acceptance is unverified, so no end-to-end Jev case is claimed.

summary.zh: MIT 文档类型分类演示：原生 Jev Choice 从21类及其他中选择，API返回候选概率供网页展示。43份合成样本的表现是作者演示，未复测真实文档，也未核实自动归档。
summary.en: MIT document-type classification demo using native Jev Choice over 21 types plus other, returning probabilities to a web UI. The 43 synthetic samples are an author demonstration, not independent real-document or auto-filing acceptance.

summary.zh: Apache-2.0 的分析工作流 MCP 服务，复用经审核卡片、来源证据和原生 Jev 的有限策略判断；输出调查/通知交接与收据，调度和消息发送由调用方负责。支持其他后端，本站未接真实 BI 或通知渠道。
summary.en: Apache-2.0 analytics-workflow MCP service combining reviewed cards, source evidence, and native Jev bounded policy judgments. It returns investigation/delivery handoffs and receipts while callers schedule and send messages. Other backends exist; no BI or messaging channel was connected here.

summary.zh: MIT macOS 原生 HTTP/MCP 代理及决策观察工具，已核查上游转发与记录管线；支持直连或自有 relay、阶段回放及导出。未安装或实机验收；开发版未公证、凭据与本地记录存储边界由使用者审查。
summary.en: MIT native macOS HTTP/MCP proxy and decision-observation tool with reviewed upstream forwarding and recording paths. Supports direct or self-hosted relay, replay, and export. Not installed or device-tested here; the unnotarized development build’s credential and local-record storage boundaries require user review.

summary.zh: MIT 代码的完整文章 Wiki/Graph RAG 助手，含需显式 live 门槛的原生 Jev 适配器和可选回答预算判断。静态展示及 Wiki/图导航基准不等于 Jev 端到端效果，本轮仅列项目，未运行模型或复测头部指标。
summary.en: MIT-code complete-article Wiki/Graph RAG assistant with an explicitly gated native Jev adapter and optional answer-budget judgments. Static replay and Wiki/graph benchmarks do not establish Jev end-to-end gains. Project listing only; no models or headline metrics were independently tested.

summary.zh: MIT 的编码路由实验库，按固定工具/模型目录运行 nconnect 与隐藏测试，区分全50任务和事后筛选的32条节省样本。依赖外部固定版本工具与付费 API，未复测；原作者文章案例已收录，不重复新增案例。
summary.en: MIT coding-router experiment with pinned tools/catalogs, nconnect, and hidden tests, separating all 50 tasks from the post-selected 32 saving cases. Requires external pinned tools and paid APIs; not independently reproduced. The author article is already a case, so no duplicate case is added.

summary.zh: MIT 编码代理协议适配网关，Auto可显式选原生 Jev、另一托管模型或本地 Laya；Jev只判断任务难度，显式用户信号优先，失败回退规则。原生客户端与路由消费已核查，未安装或复测成本。
summary.en: MIT coding-agent protocol gateway whose Auto mode can explicitly select native Jev, another hosted model, or local Laya. Jev judges task difficulty; explicit user signals take priority and failures fall back to rules. Native client and routing consumption reviewed, without installation or cost reproduction.

summary.zh: Obsidian 既有标签 Noul 打分插件，矩阵审阅后采纳写入；独立实现受 Kaku 公开交互启发。已核 API、分桶与文件写入接线，未安装或复测；笔记会离机，缺失答案补0和粗费用有局限。
summary.en: Obsidian Noul scoring over existing tags, with matrix review before accepted writes. Independent implementation inspired by Kaku’s public UX. API/bucketing/write wiring reviewed without installation or retest; notes leave the device and zero-filled answers/rough costs have limits.

summary.zh: Android 启动器，强词面匹配优先，原生 Jev Choice/Noul 补语义应用候选，用户确认后启动；另含应用类别分配。未安装或核验商店状态，设备效果为作者自报，经验阈值非准确率保证。
summary.en: Android launcher prioritizing strong lexical matches and adding native Jev Choice/Noul semantic candidates for user-confirmed launch; also categorizes apps. Not installed or store-verified; device behavior is author-reported and heuristic thresholds do not guarantee accuracy.

summary.zh: Command Code 的 Jev 判定 mod，复用 jev-guard 策略并接入工具阻止、交互确认、权限请求及内容扫描。默认 fail-open、headless ask仅警告，支持非Jev自定义后端；仅源码核查，不作安全效果保证。
summary.en: Command Code mod reusing jev-guard judgments with tool blocking, interactive confirmation, permission requests and content scanning. Defaults to fail-open and warning-only headless ask; custom backends can be non-Jev. Source-reviewed, without a safety-effectiveness claim.

summary.zh: Harness² 社区分支，含原生 Jev 候选成品评分选择与飞机/路标视觉演示；Jev 做结构化判断，外围框架迭代提示和工具。已核消费者与根许可，未运行；非 Google/TypeSafe 官方 Jev 集成，照片许可另计。
summary.en: Community Harness² fork with native Jev final-output scoring/selection and aircraft/road-sign vision demos. Jev supplies typed judgments while the surrounding framework refines prompts/tools. Consumer and root license reviewed, not run; not an official Google/TypeSafe Jev integration and photo terms are separate.

summary.zh: MIT Claude Code插件，经jev CLI在有限选项旁显示概率，默认用户选择；显式auto_select可替答。已核hook/消费者，未安装；作者偏好匹配率并非独立验证，选取上下文会外发。
summary.en: MIT Claude Code plugin displaying jev CLI probabilities beside bounded options; users choose by default, with explicit auto-select available. Hook/consumer reviewed without installation; author preference-matching rates are unverified and selected context is transmitted.

summary.zh: Apache-2.0本地arXiv集合图插件：关键词召回/集合操作加原生Jev筛选和分类，逐批持久化概率与进度。未安装、未复测万篇时间；本地数据库不等于本地推理，召回受入库范围约束。
summary.en: Apache-2.0 local arXiv set-graph plugin combining keyword recall/set operations with native Jev screening/classification and batch-persisted probabilities/progress. Not installed or timing-retested; local database is not local inference and recall depends on ingested coverage.

summary.zh: MIT篮球视觉、统计与解说原型，含原生Jev SDK、有限教练卡片/解说类型判断和确定性回退；live、stub、replay、off分开。已核调用和消费者，未接真实比赛或复测，模拟与测试数不代表实场准确率。
summary.en: MIT basketball vision/stats/narration prototype with native Jev SDK, bounded coach-card/line-kind judgments and deterministic fallbacks. Live/stub/replay/off are separate. Calls/consumer reviewed without real-game or performance tests; simulations/test counts do not establish field accuracy.

summary.zh: MIT SAP CAP内部System One决策服务，验证Choice/Score/Noul并支持超时、重试、Destination与mock。当前Cloudflare provider默认Clef，通用兼容接口不等于已验证TypeSafe Jev业务调用；仅列相关工具，未安装或验证npm发布。
summary.en: MIT internal System One decision service for SAP CAP, with typed validation, deadlines/retries, Destination and mock support. Its current Cloudflare provider defaults to Clef; compatibility does not establish a verified TypeSafe Jev business call. Related tool only, not installed or npm-publication verified.

summary.zh: MIT双臂布料分拣视频标注管线，把本地兼容决策模型的形状投票与几何规则合并成篮筐红框，释放后停止跟踪。默认本地StartLux/jev兼容服务，非TypeSafe托管模型验收；权重/机器人数据不含，权重另有非商业限制，未运行。
summary.en: MIT dual-arm fabric-sorting video annotation pipeline combining local compatible-model shape votes with geometry to draw basket boxes until release. Defaults to a local StartLux/jev-compatible service, not verified hosted TypeSafe use. Weights/robot data are excluded; weights have separate non-commercial restrictions. Not run.

summary.zh: MIT通用决策护栏与审计工具：扫描不可信内容，擦除片段重判，再以策略生成复核/弃权/阻止等结果。已核管线和兼容HTTP适配，示例主要为独立本地模型，不当TypeSafe Jev效果；未下载权重或复测安全指标。
summary.en: MIT generic decision guards/audit tooling: scans untrusted content, rejudges erased spans and applies review/abstain/block policies. Pipeline/compatible HTTP adapter reviewed; demonstrations mainly use independent local models, not proof of TypeSafe Jev results. No weights downloaded or safety metrics retested.

summary.zh: 维护 tamaratran 压缩工具的 MIT 分支：保全并行工具结果、长会话窗口、外发脱敏与超时回退。已核调用和 hook；默认保留工具调用，显式配置才可删。未发布该分支 npm 包，未安装或复测，不重复计同类案例。
summary.en: MIT maintenance fork of tamaratran’s compactor with parallel-result preservation, long-session windows, redaction and timeout/fallback handling. Client/hook reviewed; calls remain by default unless explicitly dropped. No fork npm release, installation or retest; not counted as a duplicate case.

summary.zh: Apache-2.0 申诉分流原型：官方 SDK 批量窄问题、版本化阈值与确定性政策输出分流/复核及审计信息。安全风险和 API 失败转人工。仅核源码，未读取投诉缓存或验证实际权益处置。
summary.en: Apache-2.0 grievance-triage prototype using the official SDK, batched narrow questions, versioned thresholds and deterministic policy for routing/review and audit output. Risks/API failures route to people. Source only; no complaint caches or real rights adjudication inspected.

summary.zh: MIT 工业缺陷图像研究工程：托管 Jev 图像调用、独立校准集与保留测试集比较；含另一条本地模型路径。R 包仍设计中；论文指标为作者自报，数据许可独立，未下载数据/权重或执行付费评测。
summary.en: MIT industrial-defect image research with hosted Jev image calls, separate calibration and held-out comparisons, plus a distinct local-model path. R package remains in design; paper metrics are author-reported, data licenses separate, and no data/weights downloaded or paid evaluations run.

summary.zh: 0BSD Obsidian 插件：原生 Jev 对笔记做封闭分类与词表标签，低概率组合需确认后写 frontmatter，排除目录先于读取。未安装、发送笔记或确认市场上架；分类质量未复测。
summary.en: 0BSD Obsidian plugin using native Jev for bounded note classification and wordlist tags, with confirmation for uncertain pairs before frontmatter writes and folder exclusion before reads. No install, note transmission or store verification; classification quality untested.

summary.zh: MIT Rust/MCP 候选工作者分配建议工具，原生 Jev 1.14 窄判断加确定性资格筛选与 hold。宿主拥有权限和执行，工具不启动工作者；公开预览只声明 Windows x64 验收，未运行真实模型。
summary.en: MIT Rust/MCP worker-assignment proposal tool using native Jev 1.14 judgments, deterministic eligibility filters and holds. Host owns permissions/execution; the tool launches no workers. Preview release validation is Windows x64 only; no live model run.

summary.zh: MIT Jev 证据账本与评估工具：原生客户端、校准/基线与跨域研究代码。其结论受样本、模型版本和实验设计限制，不能写成普遍性能事实；未读取原始邮件语料、运行实验或复测指标。
summary.en: MIT Jev evidence ledger/evaluation tooling with a native client and calibration, baseline and cross-domain research code. Conclusions are limited by samples, model versions and study design, not universal performance facts. No raw email corpora read, experiments run or metrics retested.

summary.zh: MIT 语义代码检查 CLI，原生 TypeSafe System One 可选后端；代码消费概率形成问题、规则违例与覆盖报告。默认云路由也支持其他模型，基准成绩必须区分后端；未上传代码、安装或复测召回。
summary.en: MIT semantic code-checking CLI with an optional native TypeSafe System One backend. Code consumes probabilities into issues, rule violations and coverage reports. Default cloud routing supports other models; benchmarks must distinguish backends. No code uploaded, installation or recall retest.

summary.zh: Apache-2.0 本地搜索/MCP 引擎，原生 Jev 为显式可选重排；已核托管调用、结果消费及外发边界。独立本地 judge 不是 Jev，概率不可直接当校准阈值；未安装、外发索引或复测性能。
summary.en: Apache-2.0 local-search/MCP engine with explicit optional native Jev reranking. Hosted calls, result consumption and egress boundaries reviewed. Independent local judges are not Jev and probabilities are not calibrated thresholds. No install, index transmission or benchmark retest.

summary.zh: MIT 实验性 React/Node 检查器：包装官方 SDK、内存记录、同源 SSE 与条件流程可视化，捕获默认关闭。演示主要用固定样本，作者未验 live inference；仅列工具，不把模拟图当真实 Jev 案例，未安装或读取 trace。
summary.en: MIT experimental React/Node inspector wrapping the official SDK with bounded memory recording, same-origin SSE and condition-flow visualization; capture is off by default. Demos mainly use fixtures and the author has not verified live inference. Tool entry only; no fixture claimed as live Jev, installation or trace access.

summary.zh: MIT 中文审核评测台，Jev 原生 provider 与四问阈值、mock/其他 provider 分开；含 CLI 与网页指标。825条标签来自公开数据映射，数据许可独立；作者preview结果未复测，不是生产审核服务验收。
