summary.en: MIT Chinese moderation evaluation console separating a native Jev provider/four-question thresholds from mock/other providers, with CLI/web metrics. The 825 labels are mapped from public datasets with separate licenses. Preview results were not retested and this is not production-service acceptance.

summary.zh: MIT 评论决策模型研究：原生 Jev 18问、其他模型对照、指标及 Elo 图表。83条评论版权独立、样本小且选择有偏；榜单/费用为作者自报，未复制语料、运行实验或下载权重。
summary.en: MIT opinion/decision-model research with native Jev’s 18 questions, other-model controls, metrics and Elo charts. The 83 opinions have separate copyrights; samples are small and selected. Rankings/costs are author-reported. No corpus copied, experiments run or weights downloaded.

summary.zh: Apache-2.0 Claude Code mod：Jev 判断草稿模型/推理强度并显示建议，不自动切换。默认Merge、可选TypeSafe直连，续接才补上下文；明显模式脱敏不等于绝不泄露，未安装或复测。
summary.en: Apache-2.0 Claude Code mod displaying Jev-based draft model/effort suggestions without switching settings. Merge is default, TypeSafe direct optional, and context is added only for continuation. Obvious-pattern scrubbing is not complete confidentiality. No install or retest.

summary.zh: MIT Ruby/原生 CLI，将团队约定转为双向 Noul 并输出行级问题及 CI 结果；TypeSafe 原生后端已核，其他后端独立。拒答/跳过不静默当通过；judge 与规则仍可能误判，未上传代码或安装复测。
summary.en: MIT Ruby/native CLI turning team conventions into paired Nouls with line-range findings and CI results. Native TypeSafe reviewed; other backends remain separate. Refusals/skips are explicit. Judges/rules can still err; no source uploaded, binary installed or tests rerun.

summary.zh: Google ADK 的原生 TypesafeClassifier 适配，支持有界题型、严格答案校验、ClassifierNode 路由和回调接线；labs 接口为实验性，通用样例默认其他模型。已核源码/文档，未安装、调用模型或验收客户流程；非TypeSafe官方项目。
summary.en: Google ADK native TypesafeClassifier with bounded question types, answer checks and ClassifierNode/callback wiring. Labs APIs are experimental and generic samples default to other models. Source/docs reviewed; no install, model calls or customer-flow acceptance. Not a TypeSafe official project.

summary.zh: MIT 自托管版本化 Skill 库，权限范围内可选 Jev Score 推荐；候选、版本和授权变化会废弃旧结果，失败明确回普通搜索，不执行Skill。量表非校准概率，任务/描述会外发；未安装、读取私有库或复测效果。
summary.en: MIT self-hosted versioned skill library with optional scoped Jev Score recommendations. Candidate/version/grant changes invalidate results; failures explicitly fall back to search without execution. Rubric scores are not calibrated probabilities and task/descriptions leave the device. No install, private-library access or quality retest.

summary.zh: MIT arXiv 日报工程，默认原生 Jev Noul 兴趣/排除筛选，代码另做机构偏好和Top K，再用DeepSeek摘要与SMTP投递。预算/预览/待发记录可查；机构偏好非客观质量，未触发工作流、模型或邮件。
summary.en: MIT arXiv digest using native Jev Nouls for interest/exclusion screening, separate institution preferences/Top K and DeepSeek summaries/SMTP. Budgets, preview and pending-delivery records reviewed. Preferences are not objective quality; no workflow, model or email execution.

summary.zh: Magpie 的 Cloudflare Jev/Clef 决策适配插件，保留state/questions并拆分层result，使answers回到顶层。package.json声明MIT，未附独立LICENSE；作者直连/经宿主自测非本站复测。未安装、读取认证或调用Cloudflare；Clef不是TypeSafe Jev。
summary.en: Magpie adapter for Cloudflare Jev/Clef preserving state/questions and unwrapping nested result envelopes to expose answers. package.json declares MIT; no standalone LICENSE. Author direct/host tests were not repeated. No install, credential access or Cloudflare call; Clef is not TypeSafe Jev.

summary.zh: Apache-2.0 推理服务的 System One 风格结构决策端点；PR #59299已合并，当前API路由可查。属于开源模型兼容工具，不代表TypeSafe Jev权重开放或效果相同；模型/读出策略限制依版本。未下载权重、启动GPU或复测。
summary.en: Apache-2.0 inference server with a System One-style structured-decision endpoint. PR #59299 is merged and the current API route was reviewed. This is compatibility tooling for open models, not open TypeSafe Jev weights or equivalent quality. Model/read-strategy limits are version-specific. No weights downloaded, GPU launched or retest.

summary.zh: Apache-2.0 文档抽取框架，经 LiteLLM Decisions 支持 Jev 的段落判定和布尔/标签/等级抽取；包含阈值、概率及多模型回退。所读示例为协议文本，不是法律验收，未安装或调用模型。
summary.en: Apache-2.0 document extraction via LiteLLM Decisions, including Jev paragraph predicates and Boolean/label/rating concepts, thresholds, probabilities and model fallbacks. Reviewed agreement examples are not legal validation; no installation or model calls.

summary.zh: MIT 菜单式决策框架，程序枚举动作、模型选择、记录证据并回放；pi-ai 分类器支持 Jev，附国际象棋和 legal-judge 域。法律评分不是法律意见，棋子素材另 BSD，未运行或验证效果。
summary.en: MIT menu-based decision harness with enumerated actions, model choices, evidence traces and replay. A pi-ai classifier supports Jev, with chess and legal-judge domains. Legal grading is not legal advice; pieces are separately BSD-licensed. No runtime or effectiveness verification.

summary.zh: MIT 校准研究：开源 scikit-learn 仿接口与真实 Jev 的 BANKING77 实验并列，含 Choice/Noul、域外与 few-shot 对比。数据另 CC-BY 4.0；作者指标不算本站复现，不是 Jev 权重开源。
summary.en: MIT calibration research comparing a scikit-learn interface with actual Jev BANKING77 experiments, including Choice/Noul, out-of-schema and few-shot variants. Data is separately CC-BY 4.0. Metrics are author-reported, not replicated here or open Jev weights.

summary.zh: MIT Gherkin/Playwright 语义测试工具，原生 Jev 选择枚举控件与动作，代码比较可核对断言，主观判断单独标注；cassette 回放不调用模型。实时页面/步骤会外发，未安装或验证第三方流程。
summary.en: MIT Gherkin/Playwright testing with native Jev choices over controls/actions, code-comparable assertions and separately marked subjective judgments. Cassette replay makes no model calls. Live steps/page text leave the device; no installation or third-party flow verification.

summary.zh: MIT 早期 HTTP 反代审核实验：固定规则与原生 Jev 双 Noul/类别 Choice 组合，支持 shadow、阈值和失败策略；也可选其他后端。作者尚未验收真实流量，脱敏不等于完整隐私保证，未部署或测防护效果。
summary.en: Early MIT HTTP reverse-proxy experiment combining fixed rules with native Jev Nouls/category Choice, shadow mode, thresholds and failure policies, plus alternative backends. Real traffic is unvalidated, redaction is not a complete privacy guarantee, and no deployment or protection test was performed.

summary.zh: MIT 证据图谱工具，区分候选提案、Jev judge、阈值与图谱写入，附预算和人工本体批准流程。参考绑定部分批处理仍用旧 OpenRouter 路由，兼容未证；仅收相关工具，不宣称本站验收了完整 Jev 构建。
summary.en: MIT evidence-graph tooling separating proposals, Jev judging, thresholds and writes, with budgets and human schema approval. Some reference batch wiring retains an unverified legacy OpenRouter route; listed as related tooling without claiming a verified end-to-end Jev build.

summary.zh: MIT Emc² 邮件客户端，提供原生 Jev 分类/三档相关性/原因标签，规则和用户教正优先，并保留本地回退。另有桌面和浏览器目标；未连接邮箱、验收存储/平台或发信，邮件字段仍会外发。
summary.en: MIT Emc² mail client with native Jev category/relevance/reason labels, rule/teaching precedence and local fallback, plus desktop/browser targets. No inbox, storage/platform or sending verification; mail fields can leave the device.

summary.zh: MIT 决策反馈框架，附原生 Jev SDK adapter、rubric/few-shot/辅助问题、ML校准和held-out候选评估；也支持其他模型。README quickstart为 ScriptedModel，不当作真实 Jev 效果；未读取事件/标签库、运行优化或下载模型。
summary.en: MIT decision-feedback harness with a native Jev SDK adapter, rubric/few-shot/supporting questions, ML calibration and held-out evaluation, plus other models. README quickstarts use ScriptedModel, not Jev evidence. No event/label stores, optimization runs or model downloads.

summary.zh: MIT Feather Wand JMeter插件，提供可选原生 Jev 工具族路由、置信卡与全工具回退，后续编辑/诊断由独立 Agent 执行。路由默认关闭、不是权限控制，其他后端不代表 Jev；未安装、压测或付费运行。
summary.en: MIT Feather Wand JMeter plugin with optional native Jev tool-family routing, confidence cards and full-tool fallback, followed by a separate editing/diagnosis agent. Routing defaults off and is not authorization; other backends are not Jev. No installation, load test or paid run.

summary.zh: MIT Worker MCP集成包，组合上游 Jev 工具、bearer接入和Agent技能/hook；原生TypeSafe或Gateway接线可查。vendor需自行生成，guard失败开放，作者亦未验部分omp接口；未安装hook、部署或验证15工具真实可用性。
summary.en: MIT Worker MCP integration combining upstream Jev tools, bearer access and agent skills/hooks, with native TypeSafe/Gateway wiring. Vendor code must be built; guards fail open and some omp interfaces are author-unverified. No hook install, deployment or live 15-tool verification.

summary.zh: GPL-3.0的HN筛选器，原生Jev批量回答Choice/Noul决策树，应用以概率/置信门槛选文章后发Telegram。树和SQLite需自行配置；未连接数据库/频道或实测周期、质量。
summary.en: GPL-3.0 HN curator batching native Jev Choice/Noul tree questions before gated Telegram delivery. Trees/SQLite require setup; no database/channel connection or independent schedule/quality test.

summary.zh: MIT OpenCode V2上下文插件，两阶段Jev Noul裁剪服务器/工具/技能描述，失败保留原请求。不是执行权限控制；默认代理端点和宿主未实测，fake-jev不是真实模型。
summary.en: MIT OpenCode V2 context plugin using two-stage Jev Nouls to prune server/tool/skill descriptions, retaining requests on failure. Not execution authorization; proxy/host untested and fake-jev is not the real model.

summary.zh: MIT邮件Agent会议演示：Jev入口/草稿出口Noul门控、观察/执行两模式及Score评估可查，只生成本地草稿不发信。演示效果与评估由作者报告，非独立安全验证；未读用户邮件或执行回放。
summary.en: MIT mail-agent talk demo with Jev ingress/egress Noul gates, shadow/enforced modes and Score evaluation. It creates local drafts without sending mail. Author results are not independent security validation; no user mail or replay execution.

summary.zh: MIT多决策模型漂移研究工具，通过OpenRouter重复冻结探针、换序/改述并报告噪声、变化与校准；数据另有条款且包含私有split。未核私有题或重测榜单，分批/并发预算检查不是硬消费上限。
summary.en: MIT decision-model drift tooling using frozen/repeated, shuffled and paraphrased probes through OpenRouter to report noise, changes and calibration. Data has separate terms/private splits. No private items or ranking reproduction; periodic concurrent budget checks are not a hard cap.

summary.zh: MIT Pi扩展集；pi-web-search可显式启用Jev分类器来判断、重排和抑制引用候选，检索与判断分离。宿主负责模型认证，所有候选先外发；未安装、读认证或验收其他扩展及性能。
summary.en: MIT Pi extension collection whose pi-web-search can opt into Jev judging, reranking and suppression of cited candidates, separately from retrieval. The host owns model auth and all candidates go out first; no installation, auth access or testing of other extensions/performance.

summary.zh: MIT电脑操作框架，Jev完成/逐要求Noul复核结合本地证据门槛，并有机械操作建议与宿主策略；原生/浏览器资格和构建依赖有边界。未安装驱动、读轨迹或复测作者可靠性，概率不是授权。
summary.en: MIT computer-use framework combining Jev completion/per-requirement Nouls with local evidence gates and mechanical-action advice under host policy. Native/browser qualification and builds are scoped. No drivers, traces or reliability reproduction; probability is not authorization.

summary.zh: Apache-2.0决策模型评估与策略执行工具，含原生TypeSafe、typed转换、显式允许连接与策略门槛/反馈。自动化覆盖和准确率是作者样本，不外推；未读私有数据、安装Skill或执行模型。
summary.en: Apache-2.0 decision-model evaluation/policy tooling with native TypeSafe wiring, typed conversion, explicit allowed connections and policy gates/feedback. Coverage/accuracy are author samples, not universal claims. No private data, skill installation or model execution.

summary.en: MIT Manifest V3 extension judging video cards with two native Jev Nouls and a substance Score, then locally hiding/dimming and caching; Shorts handling is local. Real-feed calibration, false removals and cache aging are unverified; no install or personal history.

summary.en: MIT Swift Agent SDK with a separate Jev DecisionProvider returning Noul/Choice/Score advice. The example defaults to a fixture and requires live opt-in. RC status and host execution qualification are separate; advice is not tool authorization. No build/install, keys or production-platform test.
